It was originally intended as a 'symbol of parting', meant to be tossed into the fire along with some fast food wrappers. Now, it's in your hands, and it symbolizes a promise to meet again.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Sarkaz's Furnaceside Fables, win a battle with Tin Man in the squad 10 times (in Regular Operations or Storyteller List).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to you, for having deeply understood how the Sarkaz's civilization developed.
'Kerdakaz,' or 'New Homeland,' is a phrase that might not find use today, but will undoubtedly become part of the lexicon in the near future.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Sarkaz's Furnaceside Fables, clear Facing Souls 4.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inlaid with silver-white crystals, shining with a pellucid brilliance.
The seeds of fate are buried deep beneath the solidified earth. All things have existed since time immemorial, but now, people can see them clearly.

An engraved medal awarded to those who braved the extreme cold and displayed the courage to explore the ends of the earth.
You've sailed many ships, rode many burdenbeasts, followed in the footsteps of a few wooden dolls, and slipped more than once on the ice. Hopefully, you found all of this enjoyable.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, pass a total of 200 nodes (in Regular Operations or Expeditioner Records).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal created due to the sheer volume of scientific research materials you were able to contribute.
There is no theoretical framework that can perfectly encapsulate all the phenomena recorded by the scientific expedition team, and nature itself will never ask 'why.'
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, reach Level 65 in Expedition Record.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations. 
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges of the icefields.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, unlock 4 squads.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal celebrating you having been blessed by this land.
No matter how special a language might be, it all began from the common desire to communicate with one another. You lean close to the earth, and receive an answer.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, trigger concord 30 times when declaring Foldartals.

medalList.description:
A commemorative medal based on the previous reports of scientific expedition team members.
There will always be uncontaminated territory in the mind of the expeditioner. The unknown begets fear, but also curiosity.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, recruit a total of 40 Operators (in Regular Operations or Expeditioner Records).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to you for interviewing many operators and compiling the corresponding reports.
The essence of prophecy is the results of synthesizing infinite amounts of information. Now, you hold enough information in your hands. Fate favors you, awaiting the day it comes to fruition.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, obtain 3 contract rewards in separate Expeditioner Records.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have gradually gotten used to the cold climate and a low-tech lifestyle.
Accordingly, you learned the locals' survival methods. You need not conquer nature, simply to live with it.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, pass Dawning Frostbounds 20 times (in Regular Operations or Expeditioner Records).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to you for witnessing a prophecy of two kinds of fates.
You may have heard the whispers of Sami's will, or perhaps seen the Cyclopes' visions. Or, you might've simply followed the thousands of branches in the forest and arrived here naturally.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, achieve 2 different endings (in Regular Operations or Expeditioner Records).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for your growing familiarity with Sami folklore and your completion of ethnographic texts.
What has been visited once will be revisited time and time again. You've learned to shift your perspective, and redefine what it means to be a 'civilization.'
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, hold 100 collectibles in the Ritual Item Catalogue.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that Valarqvin prepared before leaving her secluded cave, representing her identity.
In her distant vision, this medal would be given to fellow travelers who reached the end of the icefields with her. She decided to award it now, and placed it in your hands.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, clear 10 battles with Operator Valarqvin (in Regular Operations or Expeditioner Records).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for your knowledge of how to survive in the northern lands.
The journey began tens of thousands of years ago, and did not end in a single day. You have been touched by the shadows deep beneath the sheets of ice, and you must decide how to deal with them within the course of your limited life.
medalList.getMethod: In Integrated Strategies: Expeditioner's Jǫklumarkar, clear Braving Nature 4.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal embedded with azure crystal, glowing with the light of life.
It carries a truth that the land-dwellers cannot comprehend: All life came from the oceans.

An engraved medal awarded for your untiring efforts to explore the depths.
The Seaborn constantly rebuild their homes. One never sees the same scenery twice.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 200 nodes in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (Regular Operations or Memory Mapping)

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for witnessing two possibilities in the depths.
The divergent thought model of the Seaborn allowed Mizuki to paint two different futures for you to observe. He smiles at the look of surprise on your face.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 2 endings in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (Regular Operations or Memory Mapping)

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for going into the oceans and beginning the exploration of the Seaborn abode.
The dwellings of the Seaborn are beautiful gardens, but you must first find the key to the gate.
medalList.getMethod: Complete Raging Billows 20 times in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (Regular Operations or Memory Mapping)

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for helping with Tulip's problems.
Your efforts have improved conditions for the Iberians, bringing vitality to this dead land. Tulip thanks you for your contributions.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 30 Regional Commissions in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
An engraved medal carved based on Operators' impressions of the ocean depths.
The ocean is vast and deep. It accepts all, human or Seaborn.
medalList.getMethod: Recruit 40 Operators in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (Regular Operations or Memory Mapping)

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for your collection and archiving of biological products.
How will people view the progress of civilization, as they look back on these objects in a thousand years?
medalList.getMethod: Own 100 collectibles in the Biospecimen Display in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations.
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges of the ocean depths.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock 4 squads in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that records the memories of many operators.
No one has unveiled fate. Your knowledge of how the events developed allows you to observe, not interfere.
medalList.getMethod: Get 3 contract rewards with different Memory Mappings in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on the theme of a self-completing ecosystem.
Humanity extracts resources from nature by destroying it. The Seaborn evolve alongside nature. Perfection should not be a characteristic.
medalList.getMethod: Reach Lv. 65 in the Ecosequence of Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded for your knowledge of the mysteries of the ocean and the Seaborn.
The ocean has its rules, and the Seaborn are not truly perfect. You know their rules. You shall determine their future.
medalList.getMethod: Complete Surging Waves 4 in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor

medalList.description:
Naturally engraved medal generated after Highmore accepted her own existence, representing her identity.
Humanity gives sentimental value to objects representing major events that they experienced, calling it a commemoration. Highmore's ownership of the medal indicates that she harbors such sentiments, as humans do.
medalList.getMethod: Win 10 battles with Highmore in Integrated Strategies: Mizuki & Caerula Arbor (Regular Operations or Memory Mapping)

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inlaid with a crimson solitaire, shining with an otherworldly light. 
The performance has come to an end, but looking back, where are the stories that belong to us?

An engraved medal awarded for your tireless exploration of the castle. 
Your hand-drawn maps have some rooms overlap while others span eerily across several floors. You suddenly realized that perhaps the castle doesn't want its true nature revealed.
medalList.getMethod: Clear a total of 200 nodes in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have experienced the duality of possibilities within the castle. 
There is no hope in the left hand, yet the right is not devoid of despair. This cyclical play is composed by the playwright and the cast, together.
medalList.getMethod: Reach 2 different endings in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have corrected chronology's flow multiple times. 
You gradually realized that the flow of time here doesn't quite abide by the laws of nature, and after several attempts, you've cracked the temporal trap left by the castle's master.
medalList.getMethod: Clear Homeland Remnants 10 times in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have assembled a vast collection of plays. 
You've gained a deep understanding of the tools of a playwright. With enough time, why not try your hand at penning your own piece?
medalList.getMethod: Obtain a total of 50 plays in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description:
A commemorative engraved medal based on many operators' impressions of the castle. 
The castle remains, continuing to grow with the collective imagination.
medalList.getMethod: Recruit a total of 40 Operators in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who have collected a large amount of the castle's treasures. 
You've gathered enough to open a museum. Unfortunately, many of the items aren't suitable for public display, and are better stored in a warehouse.
medalList.getMethod: Integrated Strategies: During the Phantom and Crimson Solitaire theme, hold a total of 100 Collectibles in the Longevity Box.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who've unlocked multiple squad configurations. 
Conditions allowing, you've designed a variety of exploration squad configurations that can effectively deal with the various challenges inside the castle.
medalList.getMethod: Integrated Strategies: Unlock 4 squads in the Phantom and Crimson Solitaire theme.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal commemorating the discovery of the story behind the castle's treasures by multiple squads. 
They tell tales that have been covered by dust, they explore possibilities of futures untold.
medalList.getMethod: Integrated Strategies: Finish 3 Contracts using different monthly squads in the Phantom and Crimson Solitaire theme.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on the knowledge revealed through the castle notes. 
After splicing together the clues again and again, you found a mark that you've seen before, on Phantom's personal belongings.
medalList.getMethod: Integrated Strategies: Level your Castle Notes up to 65 in the Phantom and Crimson Solitaire theme.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal akin to the badge worn by Shalem during his time with the Crimson Troupe, representing his identity. 
The badges of the failed were cast into the flames where they would die along with their owners. Yet, Shalem still lives, and as has his badge—a dramatic achievement, in a sense.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain a total of 10 victories using Operator Shalem in the Integrated Strategies: Phantom & Crimson Solitaire (regular operations or monthly squad).

medalList.description: You collected an entire set of furniture for the first time.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 1 furniture set

medalList.description: You collected several sets of furniture.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 5 different sets of furniture in total

medalList.description: You collected ten sets of furniture. Looks like you really enjoy interior decorating.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 10 different sets of furniture in total

medalList.description: You collected a decent amount of furniture sets. Closure looks real happy.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 15 different sets of furniture in total

medalList.description:
You've collected many sets of themed furniture, and the Procurement Department will notify you as soon as new items are available. 
The furniture sets you've purchased greatly improve the ambience of your operators' dorms.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 30 different sets of furniture in total

medalList.description: Your Factory has begun operations.
medalList.getMethod: Produce any formula 1 times in the Factory

medalList.description: Your Factory's operations are stable.
medalList.getMethod: Produce any formula 25 times in the Factory

medalList.description: Your Factory's operational output is on the rise.
medalList.getMethod: Produce any formula 100 times in the Factory

medalList.description: Your Factory's operational output has been greatly improving.
medalList.getMethod: Produce any formula 500 times in the Factory

medalList.description:
Your Factory has really taken shape.
Perhaps manufacturing will become one of Rhodes Island's most important sources of income in the future.
medalList.getMethod: Produce any formula 1000 times in the Factory

medalList.description: Your Workshop has begun operations.
medalList.getMethod: Process 1 type of elite material at the Workshop

medalList.description: Your Workshop's operations are stable.
medalList.getMethod: Process a total of 5 different types of elite material at the Workshop

medalList.description: Your Workshop's operational output is on the rise.
medalList.getMethod: Process a total of 10 different types of elite material at the Workshop

medalList.description: Your Workshop's operational output has been greatly improving.
medalList.getMethod: Process a total of 20 different types of elite material at the Workshop

medalList.description:
Engraved medal gifted with the Duel Channel: Ivy Vine event icon.
This season could not have succeeded without your participation, and your generous sponsorship, of course.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Ivy Vine' event, obtain the 'ALL IN!' icon.

medalList.description:
You ranked amongst the top gifters in a Duel Channel: Ivy Vine competition.
You have earned recognition for your discerning eye. Now, can you tell me, quietly, which side to pick next?
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Ivy Vine' event, finish in the top 3 once in any mode.

medalList.description:
You united the people of the Katorga Raion, broke the quarantine, and stepped toward freedom.
'What an amazing force that was! And that very force lies within us! It inspires us to live, and to fight against fate!'

You obtained recognition for being the only one who could provide a signal from the Katorga quarantine zone.
Listen, and speak out in your own voice. So that more may hear you—not just for the truth, but to create real change.
medalList.getMethod: During the People, A People event, obtain the free Operator Botani.

medalList.description:
You collected the scrap pages of youth and ignited them to give birth to new life.
'Call it lame poetry, call it rank nonsense. No matter what you say about it, if I don't write it, how will future generations know what happened? How will I prove that I ever existed?'
medalList.getMethod: During the People, A People event, consume 4000 Broken Verses in [Snow-Soaked Campfire]

medalList.description:
You escaped the Katorga quarantine.
The snow is falling, and the blood is flowing. The snowflakes fall on this city with over a thousand years of history, and also on the shoulders of every person within it. They have cast aside their naive and childish fantasies, and are moving towards a new era.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Beyond the Days of Innocence] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You witnessed the opening and closing of the '87th Provisional Inquiry Hearing'.
'Fearsome debate is also a form of combat. Violence is not the only way. We are not ignorant brutes. Our ultimate objective is peace!'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [The Hearing] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
An old friend from Rhodes Island selflessly offered aid, which you deployed expertly in battle.
'This is different from my Originium Arts, but the principle is similar: use the spare scraps around you, and turn trash to treasure. This is common knowledge in Ursus, a requirement for survival.'
medalList.getMethod: During the People, A People event, use Disguise Kit a total of 40 times

medalList.description:
You rescued your companions, who were unjustly imprisoned in the Katorga quarantine zone.
'Who are our comrades? Students, workers, merchants... all those who have been unjustly oppressed!'
medalList.getMethod: During the People, A People event, rescue a total of 20 Jailed Students.

medalList.description:
You defeated all the enemies blocking us from escaping the Katorga quarantine zone and running toward a new future.
We move towards the rising sun—we are the rising sun!
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Toward the Dawn of Resurgence] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You made the Katorga quarantine zone Sentry Turrets spin in circles.
You must become a lethal shadow amidst the rusted steel. Strike fear into the hearts of these brutes, and punish them.
medalList.getMethod: Clear PA-5 with a 3-star rating and be spotted by Sentry Turrets no more than 4 times.

medalList.description:
You rejected the ridiculous quarantine and protected your companions.
Humanity is by nature free.
medalList.getMethod: Clear PA-8 with a 3-star rating, and have no more than 2 Operators be imprisoned in Cells

medalList.description:
You have fulfilled all the terms of the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2.
It was designed to optimize Rhodes Island's response to extreme crises, and you have carried out the mission flawlessly.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Key Objectives] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2 outfit.
Rehydrate, recharge, and then set out again!
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2 event, obtain the outfit Hydration Time

medalList.description:
You have fully experienced all Perilous Simulations within the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2.
These sorts of simulations may be flawed, but they are enough to prove the necessity of team combat.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2 event, clear [Perilous Simulation] once

medalList.description:
You successfully activated many alliances during the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2.
An excellent commander can bring out the best from every soldier under their command, and you have proven yourself in this regard.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2 event, use a total of 8 different Alliances to clear any simulation

medalList.description:
You have put multiple strategies to optimal use in Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2.
Decision-makers need to not only thirst for victory, but to have the courage to be bold and break through. Your performance was perfect.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance - Part 2 event, use 5 different Strategies to clear any simulation (not including Entry Protocol)

medalList.medalName: Trial from Misery: Medal of Excellence
medalList.description:
You have passed all assessment requirements in 'Vector Breakthrough #2 Trial from Misery'.
Based on your overall performance, training officer Misery has evaluated your performance as 'excellent'.

medalList.medalName: Trial from Misery: Medal of Triumph
medalList.description:
Your squad passed all tests on the All-Out Effort training grounds.
A real battlefield does not come with a difficulty setting, and your courage to tackle challenging difficulties is deserving of praise.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete all stages in [All-Out Effort]

medalList.medalName: Trial from Misery: Combat Attire Medal
medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit obtained from Vector Breakthrough.
He journeys through streets and alleys, through wind and rain, bringing the light of hope.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, obtain the outfit My Fellow Newsboy

medalList.description:
Your squad successfully defeated every enemy in the Special Front training grounds.
History is full of brave warriors who fought alone, but here we value unity, cooperation, and mutual support more than sacrifice.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete all stages in [Special Front]

medalList.description:
Your squad was unbeatable in the Kernel Breakthrough training grounds.
Oftentimes there is more than a single path to victory, but usually there is only one factor that determines a win.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete all stages in [Kernel Breakthrough]

medalList.description:
Your squad charged straight into the Special Front training grounds and defeated many enemies.
It is hard to say whether defending or attacking is more valuable, for either option proves itself under the right strategy.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete any 8 stages in [Special Front]

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully stopped the attack of the training officer, 'Misery', Blade of Silence.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, cause 'Misery', Blade of Silence to move to a night tile 5 times after entering your Operators' visibility

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully passed a Vector Breakthrough assessment, and broke through the terrifying night.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete VEC-03 and awaken a Knight Territory Wanderer early

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with furniture obtained from Vector Breakthrough.
It is not easy to earn the approval of the training officer, but this plaque is proof that you succeeded.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, obtain the furniture Plaque - 'Misery'

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully passed a Vector Breakthrough assessment, and demonstrated fearless courage.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #2: Trial from Misery, complete VEC-05 and deploy at least 1 Ground Operator

medalList.description:
You have journeyed all across Yan, seen the summers and winters, and witnessed the sun and moons rise and fall many times.
The years come and go, and sun and moon mark the ages, but he has made them his eyes, seeing the dead end when he opens them, and the mortal world when he closes them.

You met a craftsman with a strange appearance in Baizao under the setting sun. The two of you chatted about your ambitions, and it was late night before you knew it.
Seeking similarity, admiring the virtuous, fostering universal love and mutual benefit... He believes in the same things you do, you both are guided by reason, and neither of you fears fate. It was a meeting of mutual delight.
medalList.getMethod: During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, obtain the free Operator Ju

medalList.description:
You visited famous mountains and delivered the historical documents you found to the calm Magistrate of Water, always buried in scrolls in the Sky Mirror Pavilion.
Years roll on, and heaven and earth are vast. How could one not fear? How could one not like it?
medalList.getMethod: During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, consume 4000 'Draft of History' in [Sky Mirror Teahouse]

medalList.description:
You were invited to a game of weiqi. Another autumn had come by the time you looked up again.
A new autumn, or the first autumn.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Record of An Autumn's End] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You touched every intersection of the nineteen lines, vertical and horizontal. Now you understand the Black player's painstaking journey, and the White player's fury.
One should know their limits, and act at the right moment. But it is those who seek a way through the impossible who understand people's hearts the best.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Proofreading of the Past] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You sit across from the strategist. The distant enemies are destroyed as the two of you talk.
No one was born a strategist, and few can reach the uncharted, distant realms, but this round will be his.
medalList.getMethod: Clear TA-9 with a 3-star rating and make 'Wield Arms' fall into pits at least 4 times

medalList.description:
You reunite with an old friend, and see knife and sword in her hand.
Many things have happened, but she remains true to her ideals, fighting for justice from country to country.
medalList.getMethod: During the First of A Thousand Autumns event, use 'Writing Knife' a total of 10 times

medalList.description:
You return to Baizao with the rest. The age of Sui is past, and the spring of 'humanity' is about to dawn.
When the truth is revealed, and forgotten secrets come to light, you will see that the people of this ancient land have more courage to face their past than you think.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Forgotten Prospect of Spring] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You slowly spread open the sheet of paper, and seem to see people both past and present walk towards you.
Leave all that has come to pass to historians' scrolls. They shall faithfully record all that we've done.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Unwritten Chapters of Yan] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You witnessed the fall of Sui.
The bestial Sui closes Its eyes, and the thousand-year calamity has finally come to an end. What night is this night, that the moons are so bright?
medalList.getMethod: Clear TA-10 with a 3-star rating

medalList.description:
You met heroes in Athenius and bore witness to a revenge.
The snow on the peaks will melt, and the rivers will flow again, just as new stories of heroes continue to be written.

You earned Xanthos's trust with your wisdom and courage.
He knows the canal inside and out, but is not always in control of the river of his own heart.
medalList.getMethod: During the Medjehtiqedti Bound event, obtain the free Operator Varkáris

medalList.description:
You experienced the voting of Athenius and collected many ostracons.
'We express our collective will by voting. It is a fair and just way of making decisions—so long as truth is in the hands of the many.'
medalList.getMethod: During the Medjehtiqedti Bound event, consume 4000 Ostracon

medalList.description:
Your courage and spirit have earned Minos's approval.
Keep the Minoan spirit in mind and bring it home, or to every corner of Terra that needs it.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Ritual of the Temple] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
Your dealings with the Astynomos of Athenius have helped you understand the ideals and methods of this reformer.
She does not care if she is understood, nor if there is anyone to walk with her. All she believes in is her own direction.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Classic Plays] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
The acolytes appreciate your help in refilling the fountains during your trip to Athenius.
'I keep tripping over myself on the streets these last few days... Fortunately, someone seems to have been refilling the fountains! I wonder who this good soul is?'
medalList.getMethod: Perform a total of 500,000 healing during the event

medalList.description:
On the bustling streets, you have learned to immerse yourself in dramatic performance, and distinguish reality from illusion. The citizens of Athenius are most impressed by your willpower.
We do need hopes and dreams from time to time, though.
medalList.getMethod: Defeat a total of 50 'Hero's Call' during the event

medalList.description:
You participated in a complete dramatic performance on the street from noon till nightfall, and did so with full passion.
'That tourist really loved theater, or at least they loved the legend of Kereseira. How committed do you have to be to stay through three straight shows?'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Theaters of the Street] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You witnessed a perfect opener, a rarity in street performances.
Just getting a full cast together is difficult enough, and you even made sure that the fountains were filled and giving off a gentle fragrance!
medalList.getMethod: Clear ME-EX-1 with a 3-star rating and all Fountains at max HP

medalList.description:
'Charge until you hit their shield wall!'
The two citizens playing Palladulis appreciate your excellent work.
medalList.getMethod: Clear ME-7 with a 3-star rating, and have a Palladulis hit terrain at least once when charging while Immersed

medalList.description:
You witnessed an Air Expo Columbia that was hard to define.
The big papers all took a guess at the accident's cause, but sadly neither 'marketing stunt' nor 'political conspiracy' would get eyes on the front page. The residents of the autonomous district poke themselves out of their offices, silently watching the 'tree' floating in the sky with pure curiosity.

Don't doubt your eyes. The 'foil-wrapped potato' in front of you really is the Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise.
Arrogance, ambition, and absurd fantasies are crammed into Skybox's pride and joy—that is, his equipment—brewing up the next big bang that promises to shatter the rules.
medalList.getMethod: During the Unrealized Realities event, obtain the free Operator Skybox

medalList.description:
Congratulations on breaking the winning streak record! These four thousand bottle caps with 'One more bottle' on them will be your lucky charms as you fly into the future.
No need to worry, you're not getting addicted to soda, you're getting addicted to the SKY!
medalList.getMethod: During the Unrealized Realities event, spend 4000 Dr Oxygen

medalList.description:
Does it represent contemporary art, or environmentalism? Is what happened on it a conspiracy cut short, or a tale only fowls could listen to?
You have watched it grow from a seed to the luxuriant tree it is now. You may look forward to seeing what sort of fruit it bears.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Air Expo Columbia] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
With your aid, all the exhibits had smooth lift-offs.
It's hard to say if these baubles floating in the sky will be swapped out in a few weeks or not. It's hardly unusual. Just hold on to the memories of novel experiences that make your head spin. No need to remember the rest.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Maintenance Checklist] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
Suggesting your friends familiarize themselves with life in the sky was a wise decision. You have shown how your gaze is locked onto the future.
'Wait a sec, you can't bring such a large party even if you flash your medals! This is Columbia's most cutting-edge scientific park, not a teambuilding funhouse for a pharma corps!'
medalList.getMethod: During the Unrealized Realities event, deploy Operators on Levitatable Zones a total of 50 times

medalList.description:
You've jumped up and down on a small experimental platform, learning that these unremarkable balloons are quite reliable. Seemingly.
The futuristic airships are packed full of eager tourists, while you crouch by the retro area's hot air balloons to warm your hands. Nobody expects you and your 'hand warmers' to break through the Starpod.
medalList.getMethod: Clear UR-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with at least 4 Powerful Balloons remaining on the battlefield

medalList.description:
You witnessed a few friends of yours light a spark aboard Propeller Paradise.
It can burn everything away, but also inspire hope. While those two possibilities are still undetermined, this park can escape via the flames spouting out of its engines.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Exodus from Columbia] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
'There might just be a flying tree in Columbia's future!'
—Writing on the packaging of a floating botanical unit made by a company imitating Rhine Lab
medalList.getMethod: Clear UR-6 with a 3-star rating, and have no Operators be defeated by 'Liberated Trees'

medalList.description:
You have heard the mutters of an elderly Banshee.
In the Convallis, sharp, grudge-filled cries and grieving whistles waft through the air like mist. Lost travelers lean against trees covered in bone fragments, the crude branches at their backs seemingly throbbing with a red-hot pulse.
medalList.getMethod: Clear UR-8 with a 3-star rating, and have no more than 8 Operators be defeated by Væla of Convallis's [Return to Oblivion]

medalList.description:
A medal personally crafted by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure.
A fist to encourage you, and also beat out a relaxing massage. 'Just smack your shoulders with it when you're tired.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock [Precision Focus], [Rapid Charge], and [Particle Tracking] Limiter Units

medalList.description:
A medal made in the image of a navigator reviewing battle records in the office.
Even if you have the perfect battle, you can still glean new ideas from the replay, for future use.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 The Fading Sonata

medalList.description:
You now know the weight of a heart, and the suffering and salvation along the heart-seeker's road.
Those with desire, those with dedication, those with devotion and reverence, those with the courage to rebel, may find their heart of hearts.

You ran into Elena as she was leading an energy survey team in the snows.
As radiant as the stars, with a heart as resolute as a boulder. That's just how her clumsy, precious movements are.
medalList.getMethod: During the Retracing Our Steps event, obtain the free Operator Astgenne the Lightchaser

medalList.description:
Your ample function testing and information retrieval was of vital import to Rhine Lab's probe research.
The researcher in charge will put your name at the very front of the acknowledgments. The day it's published, all will know your name.
medalList.getMethod: During the Retracing Our Steps event, spend 4000 Multi-functional Snow Detectors at the [Observatory Support Division]

medalList.description:
A riddle, the most basic form of question and answer.
The seekers no longer seek, the questioners no longer question. Rise from the straw prayer mat, and with your two unfettered legs, walk a new road.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Oracular Riddles] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You walk among the ruins, the once-gleaming trains still before your eyes.
Resource allocation and time management have proven to be rigorous tests of your ability. Oh, and take care, the floor's slippery.
medalList.getMethod: In [Karlan Trade R&D], clear a total of 8 rebuilding regions

medalList.description:
Distant, docile snow is a beautiful sight. Approaching, tumbling snow is a disaster.
Put down your broom—we won't be able to use it for a while.
medalList.getMethod: During the Retracing Our Steps event, use Avalanche Trigger System, Snow Retention System, or Avalanche Control System 15 times

medalList.description:
You have witnessed a wayward pilgrimage.
The law states that once the Saintess leaves the Vine-Bead Court, she is to tour the mountains of Kjerag alone, using her two feet to measure the weight of faith and prayer.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Pilgrimage through Blizzards] with 3-star ratings

medalList.description:
You walk alongside the trailblazer of transformation. The heavy curtain is pulled back for the both of you.
Eyes that see the way through the blizzard, hands that dig tinder out of cold soil, courage that sets legs walking across the ice. They come together to form the him you know.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Road of Reformation] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You wait within the crowd. Some journeys must begin by one's own hand.
One step, then another. 'Where are we going?', you hear someone ask. Then another step.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Heart of Karlan] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
Kjerag has no zoo. The animals here are freer than you imagined, and are more willing to be friends to humanity.
Your new friend is showing you how nimble its flips are again. Please prepare to applaud and offer a treat.
medalList.getMethod: During the Retracing Our Steps event, flip 30 Frostdillos

medalList.description:
You have fulfilled all the terms of the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
It was designed to optimize Rhodes Island's response to extreme crises, and you have carried out the mission flawlessly.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Key Objectives] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance outfit.
The blazing sun disperses the haze, its passion impossible to resist.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance event, obtain the outfit Blazing Street View

medalList.description:
You have fully experienced all Standard Simulations within the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
These sorts of simulations may be flawed, but they are enough to prove the efficiency of team combat.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance event, clear [Standard Simulation] once

medalList.description:
You have fully experienced all Perilous Simulations within the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
These sorts of simulations may be flawed, but they are enough to prove the necessity of team combat.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance event, clear [Perilous Simulation] once

medalList.description:
You have put multiple strategies to optimal use in Stronghold Protocol: Alliance.
Decision-makers not only need to be certain of victory, they must also have the courage to bear the trust of others. Your performance was perfect.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol: Alliance event, clear any 3 simulations with 1 Strategy (not including Entry Protocol)

medalList.description: The Icebreaker Games have the spotlight today thanks to your wholehearted support.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, obtain all other medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who participated in a large number of events in Icebreaker Games #2. Do it enough times, and you'll eventually win one!
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, earn a total of 50 Merit Medals in [Regular Events].

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Beginner division in Icebreaker Games #2.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, complete 3 [Regular Events: Beginner] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Advanced division in Icebreaker Games #2.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, complete 3 [Regular Events: Advanced] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Expert division in Icebreaker Games #2.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, complete 1 [Regular Events: Expert] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded to those who protected their position in Bastion Defense in Icebreaker Games #2.
Grit, determination, courage. These are what make the athletes who show outstanding performance at this event.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, battle 2 different Monuments of Trial in Bastion Defense.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded to those who gathered many Supplies Floaters in Obstacle Drift in Icebreaker Games #2.
The athletes spare no effort when it comes to Obstacle Drift. The competition is fiery-hot in this event that demands both skill and luck.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, have 2 Supplies Floaters on the Drifter when clearing Obstacle Drift.

medalList.description:
Medal archived with the competition photo reel.
The valiant performances of the athletes under the lens, alongside this medal, will serve as eternal mementos of this glorious competition.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, submit 2 sets of photos.

medalList.description:
Your title, alongside your many accomplishments, has been showered with praise in the arena.
Which title of yours is the audience shouting out?
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, earn a total of 20 titles.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded with an outfit. Serves as a tag as well.
Style and performance in one. That's the Icebreaker spirit.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #2, obtain the outfit One-man Racing Team

medalList.description:
You have successfully established many frontier outposts in Rebuilding Mandate.
Thanks to your directives, many manufacturing bases have sprung up in distant lands. What they support are Rhodes Island's hopes for the future.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rebuilding Mandate event, clear all standard levels

medalList.description:
You have successfully established many frontier outposts in dangerous territory in Rebuilding Mandate.
Thanks to your directives, even the most perilous environments have Rhodes Island manufacturing bases operating at high efficiency. The troubles we face now are all for the sake of a smoother road in the future.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rebuilding Mandate event, clear all adverse levels

medalList.description:
Engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Rebuilding Mandate.
Cool-colored chords reverberate freely.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rebuilding Mandate event, obtain the outfit Cool Colored Rock 'n' roll

medalList.description:
A medal awarded alongside furniture in Rebuilding Mandate.
A gift from the frontier outposts, to commemorate all the production modules you have deployed. As for the small metal crabs that came with it... Eh, an accident during transport.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rebuilding Mandate event, obtain the furniture 'Emergency Record' Vivarium

medalList.description:
You have given many operators plenty of effective manufacturing training in Rebuilding Mandate.
Everyone here has the courage to start from scratch, and is unafraid of hardship. We'll use what Rhodes Island taught us to build Rhodes Island!
medalList.getMethod: During the Rebuilding Mandate event, promote 8 Operators in the Armory to Elite 2

medalList.description:
Engraved medal gifted with the Duel Channel: Honeydew event icon.
This season could not have succeeded without your participation, and your generous sponsorship, of course.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Honeydew' event, obtain the 'Perfect!' icon.

medalList.description:
You ranked amongst the top gifters in a Duel Channel: Honeydew competition.
You have earned recognition for your discerning eye. Now, can you tell me, quietly, which side to pick next?
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Honeydew' event, finish in the top 3 once in any mode.

medalList.description:
You spent a series of uncanny summer nights in Mitsukue.
Reluctant or relieved, they all reached their end. What remains will gather itself in a day and return at night, at its best.

Beyond profit and calculation, you were granted trust and a promise.
The owner of this azure gaze ceased a long search, passing through old dust to look toward the road you will take.
medalList.getMethod: During the Ato event, obtain the free Operator Matsukiri.

medalList.description:
You collected so many Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken you looked like the most fanatical of fans.
Some people consider others' existence as the light in their lives; and believe the pursuit of that light is worth any price.
medalList.getMethod: During the Ato event, consume 4000 Performer Meeting Chuusen-ken in [Vintage Bazaar].

medalList.description:
You know the city's secrets and alleyways better than any Mitsukue local.
The retro and the avant-garde are endlessly deconstructed and remade, yet you still find the unchanging daily life beneath.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all entries in [Mitsukue Guidebook] and claim the reward.

medalList.description:
You helped Tooru Moriuchi run his intelligence hub and earned him treasures he'd never seen before.
'And you? What do you want to know? I promise I'll tell all I know.'
medalList.getMethod: In [Soudanshitsu Mikage], obtain 175,000 'Treasure Pouches'.

medalList.description:
You pressed that switch again and again, with the irrefutable posture of determination.
Did you embrace fate, or did fate entice you?
medalList.getMethod: Activate Fate Striker 20 times during the event.

medalList.description:
You witnessed a sparse but brilliant fireworks night.
Even a homesick traveler found a diminutive bloom of their own.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [District of Eternal Neon] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You unraveled the decades-old rumors that clung to Mitsukue.
Answers slowly took shape, then swiftly faded. Facts were scarce; only interpretations remained, and people tirelessly wove new tales from the barest threads.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Remnants of Kajimachi] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You accompanied an Oni on her final journey home.
At the riverbend of return only abandoned reflections remained, where new rumors had already begun to grow.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Stairway to Severance] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
Considering the potential casualties, you denied those machines the chance to take it out on humans.
A small deviation robbed those iron frames of combat power, sending them to sleep along the fate you chose for them.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, destroy 30 inactive Stress-Relief Helpers using 'Certain Fates'.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal cast from the silhouette of a colossal structure rising on the horizon.
What it casts on this land is not a shadow but a dawn line of history—keep walking, always facing the future.

An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Battleplan Arclight.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, reach a score of 300 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Battleplan Arclight.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, reach a score of 600 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who overcame countless hardships during Battleplan Arclight.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, complete all of Main Test Site's Objective Sets (Excluding Objective Set: Emergency Response).

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Battleplan Arclight.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, complete any key node in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who defended the front lines during Battleplan Arclight.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, complete any key node in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Battleplan Arclight.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, complete all key nodes in all Rotating Test Sites.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Battleplan Arclight.
Sunlit seas and salted breeze refresh the mood.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, obtain the outfit Holiday HD75.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who dedicated themselves to forging continuous progress during Battleplan Arclight.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, reach a best score of 100 in any Main Test Site category.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Battleplan Arclight.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Arclight, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation at least 5 times.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal from the Holographic Combat Matrix granted to the first to survive desperate ground.
Past battles were grueling; you now meet them with composure.

An engraved medal from the Holographic Combat Matrix awarded to those who bested the march.
The highest respect for an opponent is to outlast and overcome them.
medalList.getMethod: Score 8 in #Death of a Patriot

medalList.description:
An engraved medal from the Holographic Combat Matrix awarded to those who defeated the swarms.
Nature gives instincts to life; yours is to pick a target, and win.
medalList.getMethod: Score 8 in #Special Operations Drill

medalList.description:
An engraved medal from the Holographic Combat Matrix awarded to those who defeated the drone fleets.
Algorithms of steel failed against your calculus of the field.
medalList.getMethod: Score 8 in #Operation Inferno-1

medalList.description:
An engraved medal from the Holographic Combat Matrix awarded to those who conquered the inferno.
What was tempered in flame is your extraordinary skill.
medalList.getMethod: Score 8 in #Operation Anemoi-2

medalList.description: A medal created by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure. While you're still napping, she's already brought you some piping-hot tea and quaint-tasting snacks as a reward.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock Limiter Units [Chain Activation], [Redundant Array], and [Full Overload]

medalList.description:
A medal inspired by the likeness of a navigator traversing through a maze.
Lies and illusions cannot deceive you. Wherever your foot falls, solid ground beckons.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Ocean Rising

medalList.description:
You witnessed Tragodia's scepter change hands.
There is no end to the birth of more stories, and no one can specify for sure what an ultimate 'aesthetic' is. He only continues on, towards the pinnacle of the stage.

You obtained special permission from Miss.Christine to rub her chin, once.
Fluffy and warm... finally you free yourself from work and sink into this wondrous sensation for a long time before coming back to your senses. Somehow your tiredness has vanished, and you feel even a little excited.
medalList.getMethod: During the Act or Die event, obtain the free Operator Miss.Christine

medalList.description:
You found mysterious black shadows scattered all over the film set, and the crew was astonished with your finds.
As you look at Miss.Christine on the camera, leisurely basking in the sunlight and happily enjoying her 'afternoon tea', you know this game will probably continue for a long, long time.
medalList.getMethod: During the Act or Die event, spend 4000 Phantoms of the Studio

medalList.description:
You enjoyed watching a play of submission, rebellion, death, and rebirth all entangled together.
Pre-written scripts of the past scatter into the wind, and now he can finally create his own future.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Performance Begins] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You visited dozens of Wrankwood's studio plates.
You saw not only the champagne and finery under leather shoes and high heels, but also how the eyes of people in different positions all light up when a movie hits the screens. That is what Wrankwood is all about.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Backlot Entertainment Projects] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
Every character's expression mixes together like a montage, and you watch the truest tale be told.
Perhaps at the very end, the lime-eyed girl with dimples on her left cheek will dance freely under the camera's lens.
medalList.getMethod: Activate Cameras a total of 20 times

medalList.description:
You lamented how drab and cramped this prop room was compared to the glistening dazzle of Wrankwood.
Here a little dream struggles, and with the tiniest leak of light from the film set, pursues the brightest spotlight on the award podium.
medalList.getMethod: Destroy Lighting Props a total of 30 times

medalList.description:
You went through hundreds of emotions and thousands of lives in this drama. Truly a fascinating experience.
Ecstasy, rage, sorrow, hate... The story ends here, but there are still those who yearn and chase after a higher art.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [For Drama, For Eternity] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You witnessed a futile struggle happen again and again for eternity.
Fabricated joys and sorrows nourish their souls, and they no longer have to consider their feelings. You know this struggle will only lead to naught, so it's best to leave at once.
medalList.getMethod: Clear AD-5 with a 3-star rating, and have a Hero's Sidekick engage in mutual combat with a Villain's Minion

medalList.description:
The insanity of drama has given birth to a false consciousness in dead matter. Fortunately, you have been sober the whole time.
The storm dissipates, and the survivors welcome their new, true lives in the wastes.
medalList.getMethod: Clear AD-7 with a 3-star rating, and do not let film thrown by Unhappy Cameramen explode more than 4 times

medalList.description:
You have passed all assessment requirements in 'Vector Breakthrough #1 Inorganic Matters'.
Based on your overall performance, training officer Mechanist has evaluated your performance as 'excellent'.

Your squad passed all tests on the All-Out Effort training grounds.
A real battlefield does not come with a difficulty setting, and your courage to tackle challenging difficulties is deserving of praise.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, complete all stages in [All-Out Effort]

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit obtained from Vector Breakthrough.
Fire ignites in her hand, as mounts nod to her will.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, obtain the outfit Ignis

medalList.description:
Your squad successfully defeated every enemy in the Special Front training grounds.
History is full of brave warriors who fought alone, but here we value unity, cooperation, and mutual support more than sacrifice.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, complete all stages in [Special Front]

medalList.description:
Your squad was unbeatable in the Kernel Breakthrough training grounds.
Oftentimes there is more than a single path to victory, but usually there is only one factor that determines a win.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, complete all stages in [Kernel Breakthrough]

medalList.description:
Your squad charged straight into the Special Front training grounds and defeated many enemies.
It is hard to say whether defending or attacking is more valuable, for either option proves itself under the right strategy.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, complete any 8 stages in [Special Front]

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully breached the defenses of the training officer 'Mechanist, Mechanical Mind'.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, break the Self-Defense Arts barrier a total of 5 times

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully passed a Vector Breakthrough assessment, and achieved some gains.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, clear VEC-07 and open all 'Treasure Chests'

medalList.description:
A medal awarded alongside furniture in Vector Breakthrough.
'The sign here says: Please do not conduct stool racing competitions on the training grounds... the floor gets way more slippery when it's high tide. For real? We better give it a try!'
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, obtain the furniture 'Slip-n-Slide of Champs'

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to spur you on after reaching a special goal in Vector Breakthrough.
Your squad successfully passed a Vector Breakthrough assessment, and managed to control some air traffic.
medalList.getMethod: During the event Vector Breakthrough #1: Inorganic Matters, clear VEC-02 and have Arc Commandos fall into pits at least 3 times

medalList.description:
You became aware of the nature of the Law.
The Holy City still stands post-calamity, and the changing of faith is not up to its founder to decide.

You met Patrizion at a screening of the 'Chainsaw Guy' series and became friends.
He is a gun-knight who guards the Holy City, but also an old man who has gone through all sorts of joys and sorrows.
medalList.getMethod: During the event The Masses' Travels, obtain Operator Sankta Miksaparato

medalList.description:
You became the most popular guest at the Shrine of Nurtury after finding so many lost baby pacifiers.
You even witnessed many of the children's halos form as they began to speak—this is when they become a 'Sankta'.
medalList.getMethod: During the event The Masses' Travels, spend 4000 Enlightened Pacifiers in [Sweet Dream Hall]

medalList.description:
You participated in a highly-anticipated Nativity ceremony.
It happens within dreams, but also in reality. Does it point towards a possible 'future', or to ruin...? It is yet incomplete.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [A Glance at the Shrine] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
Be it a rampaging rockhorn or a giant milk bottle spurting wildly, they will all fall into slumber under your gentle voice.
The Shrine of Nurtury has fostered innumerable creatures both living and dead, and it is no easy matter to have them share the same dream in peace. Fortunately, you can touch on their common nature.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Babysitting Criteria] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
Be it a snoring rockhorn or a giant milk bottle wearing a halo, they will all return to reality through your efforts.
The Shrine of Nurtury has fostered innumerable creatures both living and dead, but where Laterano should go ought to be for the Laterans to decide.
medalList.getMethod: During the event The Masses' Travels, deploy Operators on Dream Tiles a total of 20 times

medalList.description:
The arborbeast high atop the trees grows a halo in dream, and you stay awake in the face of this wondrous sight.
Life is a wonderful thing, one that can never be measured by the confines of common sense. This you know all too well.
medalList.getMethod: Clear MT-8 with a 3-star rating, and defeat the 'Matriarch'

medalList.description:
You witnessed a different sort of 'pilgrimage'.
It existed in the past, and happened again in the present. Then, the Sankta met the Law, and now, the Sankta define it on their own terms.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [An Audience with God] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You met a mysterious guest in the faded Holy City.
All that happened in Laterano was but the start of Terra's future.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Rest in Peace] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You stopped by a firearms workshop and got a hands-on lesson on how to craft a gun.
The grumpy gunsmith gives you a high rating, and the children invite you to take a photo together after obtaining their patron firearms. Their smiles are also part of your reward.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all orders from any 2 characters in [A Firearm Technician's Night] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
Engraved medal gifted with this season's Duel Channel avatar.
This season could not have succeeded without your participation, and your generous sponsorship, of course.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Green Grassville' event, obtain the 'Give It Back!' avatar.

medalList.description:
You ranked amongst the top gifters in a competition.
You have earned recognition for your discerning eye. Now, can you tell me, quietly, which side to pick next?
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Duel Channel: Green Grassville' event, finish in the top 3 once in any mode.

medalList.description: Your support was crucial to the Icebreaker Games becoming a regular event on Rhodes Island.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, obtain all other medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who participated in a large number of events in Icebreaker Games #1. Do it enough times, and you'll eventually win one!
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, earn a total of 50 Merit Medals in [Regular Events].

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Beginner division in Icebreaker Games #1.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, complete 3 [Regular Events: Beginner] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Advanced division in Icebreaker Games #1.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, complete 3 [Regular Events: Advanced] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description: Medal awarded to those who performed well in the Expert division in Icebreaker Games #1.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, complete 1 [Regular Events: Expert] with 3 Merit Medals.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded to those who protected their position in Bastion Defense in Icebreaker Games #1.
Some players form an impregnable wall just by standing there.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, withstand a total of 20 waves in Bastion Defense.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded to those who scored a large number of goals in Positional Football in Icebreaker Games #1.
Scoring more goals—that's what it's all about.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, score a total of 20 goals in Positional Football.

medalList.description:
Medal archived with the contestant album.
Making an album is a kind of commemoration, and this medal is a commemoration of the creation of that commemoration.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, submit 2 sets of photos.

medalList.description:
Your name is known throughout the arena—more than one name, in fact.
Which one would you prefer to be known by?
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, earn a total of 30 titles.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded with an outfit. Serves as a tag as well.
Style and performance in one. That's the Icebreaker spirit.
medalList.getMethod: During Icebreaker Games #1, obtain the outfit Playfellows.

medalList.description:
You learned what happened at the wake on the eve of that Samhain.
May the flame that burns all to ashes become the lamp that drives out cold and darkness.

You befriended the descendant of one who cast aside the crown.
Resolve and kindness are hereditary too.
medalList.getMethod: During the When Elegies Are Ashes event, obtain the free Operator Brigid.

medalList.description:
You recovered the Originium lamps of the departed, returning them to those who still remember.
Take heart, for not everyone is fortunate enough to be remembered in this place.
medalList.getMethod: During the When Elegies Are Ashes event, spend 2400 Broken Originium Lamps.

medalList.description:
You heard out the story told by one who lost his words.
Losing his words was the last dignity afforded to him.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Flickering Shadows] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You are confident that Na Saoirsí's winter will be bright and warm.
'And so in my dreams I go, lighting bonfires in the woods, lighting the path you trod.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Griefs yet to Relieve] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You eliminated many strange saplings from the Dark Woods.
Would they still grow into plants, if the black mist were dispersed?
medalList.getMethod: Defeat a total of 100 Cabbage Seedlings and Cabbage Weeds in the event.

medalList.description:
You met the mischievous fae of the Dark Woods.
Would they be satisfied with mere pranks, if the sun shone into the woods?
medalList.getMethod: Expose 15 'End Points' and 'Middle Points' early in the event.

medalList.description:
You followed the fire to walk the path of the living, leaving the departed behind.
The elegy that has been sung for a thousand years shall turn to ashes with the rising sun.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Dying Flames] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You stopped the withered branches from growing out of control in the Dark Woods.
Do not allow them to twist everything touched by the black mist.
medalList.getMethod: Clear EA-4 with a 3-star rating and allow no more than 6 Thickets to spawn.

medalList.description:
Time and again, you denied the purple fire its fuel, until it is extinguished from Tara.
When the sun rises, life will truly begin.
medalList.getMethod: Clear EA-8 with a 3-star rating and allow 'All Flames Returned' to revive and re-enter the Spin state no more than 3 times.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal depicting the crystal clusters and storms that scatter pain throughout the canyon.
Sin and hatred will eventually crumble into dust, then vanish with the wind.

An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, reach a score of 300 in Main Test Site.

medalList.medalName: Extinguished Sins: Commemorative Contract Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, reach a score of 600 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who overcame countless hardships during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, complete all of Main Test Site's Objective Sets (Excluding Objective Set: Emergency Response).

medalList.medalName: Extinguished Sins: Call to Arms Medal
medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, complete any key node in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who defended the front lines during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, complete any key node in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, complete all key nodes in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
Engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
The camera focuses in to catch the latest fashion.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, obtain the outfit Cover Mercenary.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who dedicated themselves to forging continuous progress during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, reach a best score of 100 in any Main Test Site category.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Battleplan Extinguished Sins.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Extinguished Sins, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation at least 5 times.

medalList.description:
Under the full moon in Baizao, you have witnessed so many reunions and separations.
Put out enough bowls and chopsticks to accommodate all the invited guests. If you wait long enough, they may just all show up.

You accepted the historian's family visit application, along with a carefully selected Yanese delicacy.
You have heard from your operators of her talent, her story, and her regrets. Soon, you will watch her write a new chapter in her own history.
medalList.getMethod: During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, obtain Operator Xingzhu

medalList.description:
You've become a regular at Savors at Yu's and have started chatting with the owner as he picks the vegetables.
You know every piece of town gossip—when the fowlbeast will return from the neighbor's roof, which nursery rhyme the scallion-seller's grandson just learned—absolutely everything.
medalList.getMethod: During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, consume 2400 'Yum-yum!' in [Savors at Yu's]

medalList.description:
You were invited to attend a grand feast.
There is no one specific 'Baizao taste'. Instead, Baizao has all the flavors under the sun: spicy, sweet, tangy, salty—you get the idea. Visitors from all over the world find a sense of belonging here.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Flavor of Food] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You helped the author of 'Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture' finish her book.
Some readers see a vivid depiction of Baizao's prosperity, while others glimpse her personal memories woven throughout its pages.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You visited one of the nodes in Baizao's efficient food supply chain and stopped a thief from stealing food.
You seized two taels of animal meat from the thief, perfectly balanced at a 3:7 fat-to-lean ratio. 'Why only two taels? Because I only take what I can eat. It's a crime to waste food!'
medalList.getMethod: Complete OR-8 with a 3-star rating with no more than 3 Sapidity or Vapidity consumed by Wealth

medalList.description:
You accepted an invitation to drink—and managed to get your companion completely hammered.
At a banquet, a few drinks are meant to lift the mood, but if someone insists on more, you will be compelled to match their zeal with even heartier toasts.
medalList.getMethod: Clear OR-EX-2 with a 3-star rating and make 'Humility' fall into pits at least 5 times

medalList.description:
You have taken in the city's thriving grandeur.
There are those who are sacrificed and those who make choices. You witnessed the hidden price of this prosperity.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Flavor of Life] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You listened to your friend list their regrets.
Life is bitter and short; reunions are few, but partings are many. There are also those you shall never see again.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Farewell, Loved Ones] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
While out on a stroll, you absorb the city's vibrant charm.
The snack shop just outside the Academy gates, the food stand on your way home from work, the luxurious restaurant that caters grand birthday banquets—in Baizao, there is a different flavor for each stage of life.
medalList.getMethod: During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, trigger 'Sapid Auspice' at least 10 times in total

medalList.description:
Engraved medal included with the Poly Vision Museum's Home Screen UI.
A meticulously designed gift, the reward a challenger rightfully deserves.
medalList.getMethod: During the Poly Vision Museum event, obtain the Interface Theme [Poly Vision]

medalList.description:
You've collected all of the Hall of Fame Badges in the Poly Vision Museum.
Upgrade step by step, and sprint for the highest score.
medalList.getMethod: During the Poly Vision Museum event, unlock all Hall of Fame Badges in Cheat Codes

medalList.description:
You are a true pirate.
What are the core qualities of a pirate? Having no home to go back to? A scary scarred face with a mouthful of sharp teeth? Or is it just an unwillingness to be trapped by the boundaries of the land?

A seal made of bone. It's been clumsily engraved with Pascuala's likeness, along with the words 'Pascuala Empire.'
'You'd better not lose it—if you ever need to do business with the great Señora Pascuala and you don't have the seal, that's on you. I won't be able to help you.'
medalList.getMethod: During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, obtain Operator Rose Salt

medalList.description:
You spent so much saltfin garum at the salt ship market that its value began to plummet.
There are drawbacks to treating a drink as a fiat currency. No matter how many goods are for sale, the amount a person can drink is limited... It's just too salty!
medalList.getMethod: During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, consume 2400 Saltfin Garum in the [Salt Ship Marketplace]

medalList.description:
You've witnessed the journey to the open seas.
People used to ask 'must all Iberians go out to sea?' Now they ask, 'must all Iberians fear the sea?'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Across the Salt Flat] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
Even in the vast desert, you've maintained your sense of direction.
The Salt Flat is as expansive as the sea of stars. While tallying their harvest on the returning salt ship, the crew tacitly avoids mentioning the next sailing schedule. After all, returning safely from the Flat without getting lost is no small feat, and they deserve to quietly savor their success for a while.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Sailing Schedule] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You've witnessed how the cruel Salt Flat can devour people in the blink of an eye.
Even the most seasoned crew members cannot differentiate between solid, walkable salt crust and the soft, salty quick-sand. The only reliable gauge is whether the person ahead of you is sinking.
medalList.getMethod: Clear EP-5 with a 3-star rating while making at least 3 enemies sink into the Salt Flat

medalList.description:
You've witnessed true 'El Dominio del Mar.'
'Fighting the wind and waves' is no mere boast. For a master of this art, the sword serves as a third leg—enabling them to dart agilely between masts. No need to even draw their sword—their enemies will lose their footing and fall overboard on their own.
medalList.getMethod: Clear EP-EX-1 with a 3-star rating while making at least 5 enemies sink into the Salt Flat

medalList.description:
You've witnessed an astonishing bout of extravagant drinking.
Saltfin garum, fine rum—each bottle in the fleet's stockpiles meets the same fate: untouched for weeks, only to be drained and discarded during a devilish night of debauchery.
medalList.getMethod: During the Exodus from the Pale Sea event, defeat a total of at least 50 Garum Gourmets and Rum Gourmets

medalList.description:
None of the many hazards in the Salt Flat can deter you.
On the land once swallowed by the sea and later disgorged, an ecosystem unlike any other on Terra has evolved. However, the ones who know this land best are not the ecologists, but a group of displaced souls about to leave it.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Through the Skeletal Reef] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You blocked the cannon's muzzle just as it was about to fire.
One of the pirates' many secrets: the heaps fired by the Saltheap Cannon are kneaded together with fin droppings. As cannons go, it's fairly weak, but no one wants to be hit with its shrapnel!
medalList.getMethod: Clear EP-8 with a 3-star rating and destroy at least 1 Saltheap Cannon

medalList.description:
You fulfilled all the terms of the Protocol.
It was designed to address any potential gaps in Rhodes Island's response to a full-scale assault, and you have carried out the mission flawlessly.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Key Objectives] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol Outfit.
So many threads—where do the clues lie hidden?
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol event, obtain the Sun Slant outfit

medalList.description:
An engraved medal included with the Stronghold Protocol Icon.
A personalized image depicting an aircraft cruising above Rhodes Island.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol event, obtain the Ship icon

medalList.description:
You have repeatedly promoted your Operators to elite status in the Protocol Simulator.
