This simulated method of studying combat performance may unlock even more of their vast potential.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol event, promote Operators a total of 50 times

medalList.description:
You have fully experienced the contents of the Protocol within the Protocol Simulator.
While the simulation still has flaws, it remains essential for optimizing Rhodes Island's internal and external defenses.
medalList.getMethod: During the Stronghold Protocol event, clear [Foundation Protocol] once

medalList.description:
You spent a long Carnevale in Nuova Volsinii.
Tear away the sinners' masks and root out the evildoers.

You met Crownslayer once again.
'Drink deep of the suffering of the dead and chew on the fury of the abandoned.'
medalList.getMethod: During the event, I Portatori dei Velluti, obtain Operator Crownslayer

medalList.description:
You became talk of the town as you carried your invitation on your extravagant shopping sprees.
Everyone can see that you're too close to La Signora del Carnevale—beware her invitations.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, I Portatori dei Velluti, consume 4000 Invito Mistic in Fiera delle Meraviglie Notturne

medalList.description:
You enjoyed the first public performance in Nuova Volsinii.
The show must go on!
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Quadriglia] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You've experienced the Nuova Volsinii Carnevale from the beginning to the end—I hope you enjoyed it.
New traditions have been added to the old holiday. The city has left the past behind.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Programma della Parata] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You set off the fireworks for Carnevale's grand display. 
'Did you choose these fireworks? Good taste. How about joining me when we light up the next city?'
medalList.getMethod: Successfully set off a Chilly Charge and clear PV-SP-1 with a 3-star rating

medalList.description:
You took down every last one of your sworn enemies: the Carnevale balloons.
By the way, the decorators are hunting the 'mysterious saboteur' who deliberately popped the balloons. Any leads?
medalList.getMethod: During the event, pop a total of 150 Balloons

medalList.description:
You led the parade on a full circuit around the entire city.
The brand-new floats circle Nuova Volsinii, promising that Siracusa will never be the same as before.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Splendida Cavalcata] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You and La Signora del Carnevale completed the Decadanza.
'Dance with me, while some of the old splendor still remains. Dance with me and in Siracusa, We Mischievous Few.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Decadanza] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You designed a lot of highly praised fireworks for Carnevale.
The festival owes much to your contributions. As such, we hereby appoint you as Artistic Director of the Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio. Sorry, it's unpaid.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 2 [Commissione di Fuochi d'Artificio] Commissions

medalList.description:
Under your leadership, the team successfully completed all Kernel Breakthroughs in Vector Breakthrough.
The operators held a party to celebrate the victory. Even Rosmontis was happy to join. She will remember these moments of growing together with everyone.
medalList.getMethod: During the Vector Breakthrough event, clear Level 8 in Kernel Breakthrough.

medalList.description:
Your team excelled on the Kernel Breakthrough training ground.
The operators eagerly anticipate each future test, hoping you'll lead them in battle.
medalList.getMethod: During the Vector Breakthrough event, clear Level 5 in Kernel Breakthrough.

medalList.description:
You led the operators in defeating a sufficient quantity of Vector Tactical Equipment.
You withstood the pressure of manifested thoughts. In fact, that very resistance has brought strength to your team.
medalList.getMethod: During the Vector Breakthrough event, defeat V. T. E. 5 times.

medalList.description:
A video game achievement medal sent from Vanilla as a thank you for guiding the team through the training assessment.
'These Originium slugs, they all listen to you now. Of course, I knew that would be easy for you, Doctor.'
medalList.getMethod: During the Vector Breakthrough event, obtain The Zoophilist and Her Mollusca outfit.

medalList.description:
Your team cut through all the challenges on the Special Front training ground.
Thanks to your knowledge of the battlefield and the enemy, the operators have achieved success in small-scale combat trainings.
medalList.getMethod: During the Vector Breakthrough event, defeat 4 different Garrisons in Special Front.

medalList.description:
You witnessed the city's rebirth from the ashes of war and intrigue.
Countless heroes remain enshrined in legend, while the homeland was rebuilt, brick by brick.

You received a firmly written request for a family visit. 
She has left the assembly line, but will never let go of the hammer that forged victory. To this day, she remains watchful and vigilant.
medalList.getMethod: During the Ending a Grand Overture event, obtain Operator Catherine

medalList.description:
You sat in on numerous parliamentary debates.
'Not happy with the state of things? Come on, let's write to Parliament. The MP from Highbury will speak on our behalf.'
medalList.getMethod: During the Ending a Grand Overture event, spend 2400 'Nay!' in the [Office of Proposed Resolutions]

medalList.description:
You have finished reading a memoir about Victoria.
When talk turns to sunsets, her thoughts harken back to the streets of Norport and drunken friends bumping fists.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Die a Hero Or a Villain] with a 3-star rating (excluding tutorials)

medalList.medalName: Parliamentary Affairs: Call to Arms Medal
medalList.description:
You leaf through the latest proposals received by Parliament.
Some of the letters piled on the desk of the new Speaker are stamped with a family's wax seal, while others are grease-stained.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all content in [Pending Bills] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You helped the workers maintain the smooth flow of goods between factories.
They showed you their blueprints, eagerly detailing plans for future rapid transit systems and quadrupedal vehicles.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GO-8 with a 3-star rating using the Munitions Factory Command Center to guide one Freight Car

medalList.description:
You delivered a large shipment of medical supplies to the besieged Londinium.
The scars cannot be erased, and many relied on cheap alcohol as painkillers. Still, they believe the worst is behind them.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GO-EX-5 with a 3-star rating while having at most 1 Freight Car destroyed by the enemies

medalList.description:
You listened to the Speaker's address to the citizens.
If radio waves aren't enough to carry her message to every Londinier, then we must go out onto the streets and deliver it to them directly.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Once upon a Time] in Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You witnessed an Aslan lay down her crown.
No one should speak of that golden lineage anymore. She holds no divine power, only a sword reforged by many hands.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GO-9 with a 3-star rating and break the Shield of Alistair, Final Flame of the Empire at least once

medalList.description:
Working hand-in-hand with the Londiniers, you unearthed many useful materials from the ruined buildings.
Some people recovered traces of their pre-war lives, but many personal belongings remain unclaimed.
medalList.getMethod: During the Ending a Grand Overture event, collect a total of 75 pieces of equipment

medalList.description:
You witnessed all that happened in Menat-Ha'mait, alongside everyone else.
The great river of time never stops. It wends its way forward for all eternity.

You climbed the stairs, passed the door, and saw an idealistic museum curator coming straight for you.
Anat's work requires absolute meticulousness. A small mistake can shatter a thousand years of history.
medalList.getMethod: During Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event, obtain Operator Papyrus.

medalList.description:
You paid a visit to Menat's Grand Bazaar, and spent your coins like sand.
Lazvar knows every store's owner, and Mio knows every store owner's pets.
medalList.getMethod: During Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun event, spend 2400 Flowing Glimmerdust in [Grand Bazaar].

medalList.description:
You witnessed the departure of an ancient guardian.
'Let me be human again, one last time.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Citizen's Garden] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorial stages).

medalList.description:
You touched the heart of an ancient city. It still pulses.
The hawkers on the street greet you as you pass, and try to sell you bricks they claim to be two millennia old.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Event Guidebook] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You witnessed constructs wreak havoc on the streets.
Gems? Glass? No-one knows what those fragments on the street are, but SOMEONE needs to clean up the mess.
medalList.getMethod: Clear AS-EX-1 with a 3-star rating, and remove a total of 40 crystals.

medalList.description:
You turned your newfound knowledge against the constructs.
There's a group of mischief-making relics sneaking into the crowd of tourists in the Grand Bazaar. They belong in a museum.
medalList.getMethod: Clear AS-EX-3 with a 3-star rating, and when placing Pure Crystals, connect 10 or more crystal together at once.

medalList.description:
You experienced all that happened in every corner of Menat.
Even the knives carried by cutpurses are older than most. This is the meaning of 'glory.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Harvest Gathering] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You decided to seal up the treasury of legend.
'According to the mayor of Menat-Ha'mait, suddenly earning that much income might require filling out fifteen separate forms explaining the situation.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Treasure House] on Challenge Mode (except AS-MO-1).

medalList.description:
You completed the Gemstone Engravings courses prepared for you by the museum.
The Originium-etched gems you personally engraved have no use other than lighting up.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 2 [Gemstone Engravings] courses.

medalList.description:
You glimpsed the origin of the war between Ægir and the Seaborn.
They both hold a twisted spark. You must make a choice.

You have cooperated with Ægir's chosen envoy to land. With her, you built a bridge between the civilizations of land and sea.
At times, crossing the boundary between different forms of civilization is harder than crossing that between different forms of life.
medalList.getMethod: During Path of Life event, obtain Operator Underflow.

medalList.description:
You find it hard to put down the Materianomicon Moderatrix. In the twinkle of an eye, this device can turn blueprint into reality.
Like many Ægir, you are obsessed with the experience of converting your idle thoughts into physical reality. It seems creating as you please is innate to all mankind.
medalList.getMethod: During Path of Life event, spend 2400 'Emergency Supplies' Blueprint Chips in [Materianomicon Moderatrix].

medalList.medalName: Commemorative Medal 'Looking at the Path Ahead'
medalList.description:
You witnessed Ægir's Waterway crossing the chaotic tides, pointing into the oceanic abyss.
You look at the Waterway stretching out to the horizon, and relief comes unbidden to you. Crisis is never far, but this time, civilization has a path forwards.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Deploy Beacons] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorial stages and story stages).

medalList.medalName: Commemorative Medal 'Birth of a New Philosophy'
medalList.description:
You lost track of time at the Sophontheatrum, solving the riddles left behind by past generations of Ægir one by one.
These mysteries feed off your thoughts, multiplying endlessly like the Seaborn. But you feel no fear. The endless unknown is what you yearn for, after all.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Conundra of the Sophontheatrum] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You taught yourself to use the Waterway Beacons, and the Academy of Technology operators couldn't help but sing your praises.
Unlike the cumbersome products of the land, Ægir devices operate as smoothly as flowing water.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BP-7 with a 3-star rating, and charge the Waterway Beacon completely, activating its effect.

medalList.description:
You exploited the Seaborn's 'carapace' process to give the legion fleets room to maneuver.
Using reason to infer instinct, much like using instinct to sense reason, is as difficult as bounding across the seas and striding into the sky. Perhaps you've learned how to take advantage of the Seaborn's instincts?
medalList.getMethod: Clear BP-EX-3 with a 3-star rating, and deploy Operators on at least 3 separate Excrescent Carapaces.

medalList.description:
Before reinforcements from Ægir's home territories arrived, you held Milliarium alongside the Ægir, civilian and soldier alike.
Even after countless, countless years, you still protect the spark of civilization. In this case, who feels satisfaction, and who feels regret?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Fortify Defense] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You did not yield when facing down the Seaborn once known as the sage Mártus.
It calmly recited your long-forgotten past, like reminiscing about an old friend. But these days, your faith will not be so easily swayed.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BP-8 with 3 stars, and no more than 4 Operators retreat due to [Humanity's Bane] from Mártus, 'Seaborn'.

medalList.description:
You aided the legions' fleets in suppressing a large amount of Seaborn.
You know the Seaborn issue cannot be resolved purely through violence, but you also know that every time the legions sweep a patch of sea clean, they are buying time for those seeking the truth of the matter.
medalList.getMethod: Defeat a total of 600 Sea Monster enemies in Path of Life event stages.

medalList.description:
You proactively participated in a number of Icebreaker Games events.
Your feats could be seen in almost every venue, and a rumor has started that you have mastered some kind of clone technique.
medalList.getMethod: During the Icebreaker Games event, obtain a total of 21 Merit Medals in Regular Events.

medalList.description:
You led your team to excellent results during the Beginner Match.
You possess superb command skills, and the brain is part of the body. So surely this also counts as some kind of strong physique?
medalList.getMethod: During the Icebreaker Games event, obtain 3 Merit Medals in any Regular Event's Beginner Match.

medalList.description:
You led your team to excellent results during the Advanced Match.
You possess rich experience in defending objectives. No matter who manages to break through your layers of defenses, you can always stop them at the last minute.
medalList.getMethod: During the Icebreaker Games event, obtain 3 Merit Medals in any Regular Event's Advanced Match.

medalList.description:
Thanks to your hard work, this Icebreaker Games event has been a roaring success.
Amongst such heated competition, even the toughest ice will melt. It seems you have perfectly grasped the moral of the games.
medalList.getMethod: During the Icebreaker Games event, obtain a total of 2100 Mementos.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal depicting THRM-EX's fantastic performance during the match.
'THRM-EX takes the ball and charges. No one can stop his onslaught! Look at that amazing midair 360! He made it past the goal line! He exploded!'
medalList.getMethod: During the Icebreaker Games event, obtain the outfit Dual-threat Quarterback.

medalList.description:
You have reviewed everything about Babel that has survived until now.
Rhodes Island continues its arduous march forward, both to keep the torrents of history from washing it back to that bygone era, and to save even more lives.

You reunited with an old subordinate.
The two of you once spent a long time together, and he is prepared to walk with you toward the future once more.
medalList.getMethod: During the Babel event, obtain Operator Odda.

medalList.description:
You retook stock of your resources from the Babel era.
Even in a time when resources are plentiful, not a single bar of Pure Gold or speck of grain is ever wasted.
medalList.getMethod: During the Babel event, consume 2,400 Raw Sugar Lumps.

medalList.description:
You witnessed the history of Babel where a belief triumphed over another.
She had faith in you. She believed in your aspirations, and trusted that your ideals would stand the test of time.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [You the Future, Take My Gifts] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You analyzed the circumstances of Kazdel's civil war.
The purest ideals clash with one another, leading to the gravest of tragedies.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [The King's Calls to Arms] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You wandered through the landship trying to recreate the scene you saw that day.
Struggle and suffering are like a silent howl echoing between each and every command.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BB-8 with a 3-star rating using Stabilizer Chains to silence Deathveil Assassin at least twice.

medalList.description:
You inspected this enormous ship and your companions once more.
This time, you are free.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BB-MO-1 with a 3-star rating triggering the effects of Stabilizer Chains at least 10 times.

medalList.description:
You found this medal among your past collection.
The glory is frozen in the past, but the responsibility has never faded.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [You the Past, Ward Me Firmly] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
The highest medal awarded by Babel, one once bestowed to you.
Time did not leave its mark on this shiny medal, nor has it diluted the expectations it represents.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [You the Constant, You Are Me] on Challenge Mode (except BB-MO-1).

medalList.description:
You viewed the records of the Babel commander who earned the title 'Evil Spirit.'
Accurate, decisive, machine-like efficiency. Cold, emotionless, and intimidating.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BB-EX-7 with a 3-star rating, and allied units are inflicted with Unsteady no more than 3 times.

medalList.description:
Medal based on the motif of glowing ocean currents in the Nethersea.
The tides constantly reach out towards the land, leaving behind traces of dawn.

An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Battleplan Underdawn.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, reach a score of 300 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Battleplan Underdawn.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, reach a score of 600 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who overcame countless hardships during Battleplan Underdawn.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, complete all of Main Test Site's Objective Sets (Excluding Objective Set: Emergency Response).

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Battleplan Underdawn.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, complete any key node in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who defended the front lines during Battleplan Underdawn.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, complete any key node in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Battleplan Underdawn.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, complete all key nodes in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
Engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Battleplan Underdawn.
Take a little break, so that you may leap towards the sky.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, obtain the outfit Easy Time.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who dedicated themselves to forging continuous progress during Battleplan Underdawn.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, reach a best score of 100 in any Main Test Site category.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Battleplan Underdawn.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Underdawn, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation at least 5 times.

medalList.description: Handmade by Closure, developer of the Trials for Navigator. She pats your shoulder, and gives you a sleeping mask and a warm blanket.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock Limiter Units [Preheated Core], [Strength In Numbers] and [Progressive Overclock]

medalList.description: Based on the image of a navigator calmly traversing the chaos of battle. Opportunities come and go in a flash, and you seized yours when it came.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Gone the Ages Past.

medalList.description:
You have tread the earth of Dahuang.
Roll up your sleeves and pants, step into the muddy water, and tend to the seedlings.

You befriended a young kite-flying Tianshi.
He steps out of Dahuang with an ancient ideal in his heart.
medalList.getMethod: During Here A People Sows, obtain Operator Wanqing.

medalList.description:
After listening to the opera, you couldn't help but buy some Dahuang specialties at the temple fair.
The Shennong Temple Fair sells things from all over Yan, just like the people here, who have come from the four corners of the land.
medalList.getMethod: During Here A People Sows, spend 2400 Sky Poles in [Shennong Market].

medalList.description:
You protected Dahuang's harvest for the year.
The people of Dahuang will not take a single step back, even for but a single grain.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Agricultural Plate] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You solve the Tianshi Bureau's age-old mysteries.
Without even realizing it, you have helped many an apprentice solve the problems given to them by their teachers.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all [Commissions from the Tianshi Bureau] and claim rewards.

medalList.description:
You saved some experimental crops from the Blight.
The Tianshis' and farmers' hard work has not gone to waste.
medalList.getMethod: Complete HS-6 with a 3-star rating and at least 2 unpolluted Farmland.

medalList.description:
You stop the pollution at its source with astute foresight.
While no fin can survive in water that is too clear, people will go hungry if the rice is lost.
medalList.getMethod: Complete HS-7 with a 3-star rating and at least 1 Miasma not having absorbed any pollution.

medalList.description:
You read the Chronicles of Shennong and learned about her life.
It sure is vivid and detailed for an account said to be written a hundred years after her death...
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [City Core] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You touched the Sui Regulator's stamp as you flipped open the final page of the copy of Shennong's surviving manuscript.
Her life in the north was not a lonely one. Her friends have survived, and her dreams have flourished.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Far Side of the Great River] on Challenge Mode (excluding HS-MO-1).

medalList.description:
The Ministry of Revenue bequeathed this shiny medal to recognize your success in tackling a century-long production problem.
'One soul lives and withers, but the myriad grains last forever.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete HS-9 with a 3-star rating and no more than 4 polluted Farmland.

medalList.description:
You boarded the train to Lake Silberneherze and safely reached your destination.
The fatal beauty keeps passing by, and the warm reprieve at the end is now within reach.

You met this viscount from Victoria during a celebration in Kjerag.
You two previously met in passing, but you never expected your reunion to come so soon.
medalList.getMethod: During The Rides to Lake Silberneherze event, obtain Operator Harold.

medalList.description:
You have opened enough Burdenbeast Blind Boxes.
The lives of burdenbeasts and the people of Kjerag are closely connected. This is readily apparent from these spectacular blind boxes.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rides to Lake Silberneherze event, spend 2,400 Burdenbeast Blind Boxes at [Onboard Services].

medalList.description:
You witnessed the Kjerag ceremony and the tides roiling beneath.
The story continues; this is both a good conclusion and a good beginning.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Platform No. 3] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You have conquered the most beautiful sights in the Snow Realm.
As mountain burdenbeasts run into the distance, with all the snow in the air and everyone's breaths visible, all worldly conflicts are immediately thrown to the back of everyone's minds.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Tourists' To-Do List] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You protected the Snow Realm's oldest resident.
Regardless of how men slaughter one another on the battlefield, burdenbeasts freely enjoy everything they encounter in their lives.
medalList.getMethod: Clear RS-EX-6 with a 3-star rating, and awaken at least 5 Slumbering Mountain Burdenbeasts using Emergency Heaters.

medalList.description:
Out of love, you were determined to protect this tiny warmth.
In the coldest of times, warmth will always guide us forward.
medalList.getMethod: Clear RS-6 with a 3-star rating, and have no more than 4 Emergency Heaters extinguished by Jet Canisters.

medalList.description:
You and your friends from the Snow Realm have defended its peace together.
No one can stop Kjerag's march forward.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Express Train] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You have completely mastered the trick to combat in the freezing cold.
This kind of mastery allows us to begin to understand Kjerag.
medalList.getMethod: During the Rides to Lake Silberneherze event, activate a total of 48 Emergency Heaters.

medalList.description:
You have become proficient in defending from attacks by foreign nations.
This difficult battle will soon become a blueprint for a novelist's next epic.
medalList.getMethod: Clear RS-EX-8 with a 3-star rating, and have 4 Emergency Heaters on the battlefield active at once.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on the firelight and the cinders rising from the remains burning in the reed beds.
Their muddled ambitions not only nourished the flames, they were incinerated in the flames.

An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, reach a score of 300 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, reach a score of 600 in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who overcame countless hardships during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, complete all of Main Test Site's Objective Sets (Excluding Objective Set: Emergency Response).

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Battleplan Pyrolysis.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, complete any key node in Main Test Site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who defended the front lines during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, complete any key node in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, complete all key nodes in Rotating Test Site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Battleplan Pyrolysis.
The raging fire is yet to materialize, but the One Blade has descended.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, obtain the outfit One Blade.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who dedicated themselves to forging continuous progress during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, reach a best score of 100 in any Main Test Site category.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Battleplan Pyrolysis.
medalList.getMethod: During Battleplan Pyrolysis, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation at least 5 times.

medalList.description:
The grandest Empresses' Celebration has come to a close. You witnessed the rebirth of Leithanien.
'I have no regrets, and I do not wonder.'

A practitioner boards the landship.
With his sword, flesh, and mind, he shall find his ideals of virtue, power, and energy.
medalList.getMethod: During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, obtain Operator Lessing.

medalList.description:
You have returned lost recollections to the city.
Everything that transpires under the Spires shall be remembered, and everything that emerges in the city can be heard.
medalList.getMethod: During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, spend 1800 die Klänge von den Erinnerungen in [Herbstmondeskonzert].

medalList.medalName: 'Only the Evening Glow is Forever Brilliant'
medalList.description:
You listened to Leithanien's Movement being performed once again.
The sins and suffering of the past have fallen into distant memory. Only the evening glow of Zwillingstürme is ever radiant.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Zwillingstürme anbeten] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You answered all the requests on the Uhrturm's notice board.
The ancient clock tower will continue to sound, but the people have already learned to seek help elsewhere.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Venesuhrenturm] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have visited every corner of the city.
You and the souls of the city chanced upon each other. You will never be rid of your impressions of Zwillingstürme.
medalList.getMethod: During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, complete 10 Routine Visitations in [Herzenfolgen].

medalList.description:
The melodies of Zwillingstürme are now in your hands.
How attractive is the idea of controlling this melody... Careful, for the idea can drive one to madness.
medalList.getMethod: During the Zwillingstürme im Herbst event, when clearing any event stage, change the Variation at least 3 times (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You reached the top of the Twin Spires, and gazed upon all of Zwillingstürme and even the entire empire.
With such an elegant view of the twenty-two cities, who wouldn't want to set foot here?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Die Gnade ist ewig] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You witnessed the end of the Pavillon.
So-called 'creations' will always crumble with time, but humanity's monument will never cease to exist.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Die Macht ist grimm] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You listened to enough melodies of the heart, and everyone's emotions now echo by your ear.
There is no way someone can remain heartless when so many pieces of complex, heartfelt music have been performed.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock a total of 10 different Aspects in [Herzenfolgen].

medalList.description:
Upon reaching the depths of the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment.
You are just one step away from a legendary victory.
medalList.getMethod: During the Design of Strife event, unlock the Formulative Battlerealm's S area: Battlefield Core.

medalList.description:
After overcoming numerous obstacles in the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment.
Your superb commanding skills were critical to your squad's success.
medalList.getMethod: During the Design of Strife event, unlock the Formulative Battlerealm's A area: Battlefield Hinterland.

medalList.description:
Upon being a good collaborator in the Formulative Battlerealm, this medal popped up after you passed PRTS's assessment. 
Cooperation is what gives rise to and sustains civilization.
medalList.getMethod: During the Design of Strife event, use support units to clear stages at least 5 times.

medalList.description:
The medal that Cardigan brought back from her hometown to thank you for helping her pass the difficult simulation training.
The medal was nice and toasty from sitting in her pocket, as warm as the gentle sunshine.
medalList.getMethod: During the Design of Strife event, obtain the Sunny Day outfit.

medalList.description: Under your leadership, Rhodes Island has been able to meet the challenges of any extreme environment.
medalList.getMethod: During the Design of Strife event, complete 3 battles in Trauma Intervention.

medalList.description:
You have a complete picture of the events that unfolded in Davistown.
A small town, where the destinies of many people intersected and turned.

You've seen what the owner of Davistown's diner is capable of.
By restaurant industry standards, she's a bit too versatile.
medalList.getMethod: During the Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event, obtain Operator Coldshot.

medalList.description:
The residents of Davistown expressed appreciation for your efforts in keeping the heaters running.
With these supplies, they can finally brave the cold winter.
medalList.getMethod: During the Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event, spend a total of 2400 Shoddy Fuel in the Shack by the Tower.

medalList.description:
You left the strife of the city behind and headed toward the wilderness.
Sometimes, leaving does not mean escaping, it just means changing directions to find a new answer.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Anemic Platform] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You've completed many missions meant for Blacksteel's seasoned mercenaries.
What this proves is that being a good mercenary doesn't always entail violence.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in the [Prize Exchange Office] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You've learned to use old-fashioned heat-dispersing equipment to defeat your enemies.
Perhaps these experiences will help you understand the importance of industrial safety.
medalList.getMethod: During the Come Catastrophes or Wakes of Vultures event, have Waste Heat Vents discharge heat a total of 180 times.

medalList.description:
You commanded your squad to attack so quickly that the bandits weren't able to make effective use of their thermal amplification devices.
Though the members of this Blacksteel team are young, they have ample combat experience.
medalList.getMethod: Clear CV-6 with a 3-star rating while not letting Paramilitary Snipers go into Overload mode more than 2 times.

medalList.description:
You resolved the troubles in Davistown, though the ending proved unsatisfactory.
It isn't until people are separated from their hometowns that they realize how precious those peaceful and dignified days were.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Black Landship] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You proactively used heat-dispersing equipment to successfully disrupt the enemy's actions.
'Clip' Cliff might just need a new suit.
medalList.getMethod: Clear CV-8 with a 3-star rating while attacking Waste Heat Vents a total of 40 times.

medalList.description:
You used the surging heat waves as cover for organizing an effective blitz.
The quicker you draw your gun, the better your odds of victory.
medalList.getMethod: Clear CV-EX-8 with a 3-star rating by defeating 'Clip' Cliff in either his first or second form while using a Waste Heat Vent to damage him.

medalList.description:
You bid farewell to the Siestan volcano with everybody else.
'It's so nice that all of you are still here by my side.'

You followed the Fashion Street pamphlet, did some sightseeing, and met a passionate Siestan teenager.
Enis invites you to visit the shops of Fashion Street, just as always.
medalList.getMethod: During the So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event, obtain Operator Bryophyta.

medalList.description:
You brought 'White Volcano' even more orders.
Enis was very happy to see everything completely sold out, only to find his cash register stuffed with pink fluff.
medalList.getMethod: During the So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event, spend 2,400 Fluffy Critter Wool in ['White Volcano'].

medalList.description:
You've completed Dolly's mission in the most outstanding way possible.
'The northern winds, seeds, fur... Not enough! Let's have some more fun!'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Dolly's Task List] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You helped Snowsant's Shop earn a considerable amount of Spending Coupons.
The small shop that's been raking in big bucks on Fashion Street has become an afternoon conversation topic to many Siestans.
medalList.getMethod: Collect 250,000 Spending Coupons from Siestan Fashion Street.

medalList.description:
You've spent a summer full of fun with the fluffy critters.
When they leave, they disappear surreptitiously without a peep, but you will never forget those strawberry-ice-cream dipped hoofprints.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [A Holiday at the Hot Springs] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
The furry creatures showed you some crazy good floating and surfing skills.
Their valiant figures as they leapt from the springwater were photographed—but it would be so much cooler if the water were shopped into lava.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Treasurehunting in Siesta] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You've witnessed the fluffy critters compete in lava freediving.
When these critters lined up and leapt into the volcano's crater, their cries formed a joyous chorus.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Treasurehunting in Siesta] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You ventured into the dangers of the volcano and returned safely with first-hand survey data.
These precious data will become a priceless exhibit in Volcano Museum of Siesta.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Surfing the Lava] on Challenge Mode (except SL-MO-1).

medalList.description:
You reunite with what was once Siesta, amid the haze and ashes.
The beach will forever be in your heart.
medalList.getMethod: Clear SL-MO-1 in [Surfing the Lava] with a 3-star rating.

medalList.description:
A medal created by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure.
Tempered by challenges, proven through trials. 'Look, didn't I tell you? It ain't that hard.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock Limiter Units [Strategy Expansion], [Experience Acquisition], and [Overcharge].

medalList.description:
A medal made in the image of a navigator who seized a favorable opportunity in the game of chess.
Sharp, unwavering, and with an indomitable will. Nothing can stand in your way.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Path of the Faithful.

medalList.description:
You've personally witnessed the Sanctilaminium Ambrosii beginning its new journey.
Some chose to leave, while those who remain will rebuild this paradise.

You welcomed a new coworker.
Though an expert in protecting himself in the workplace, he's actually quite the professional.
medalList.getMethod: During the Hortus de Escapismo event, obtain Operator Insider.

medalList.description:
The devout are thankful for your assistance.
You overhear someone wishing for your wellbeing as the residents pray before the statue.
medalList.getMethod: During the Hortus de Escapismo event, spend 2,400 Statue Fragments in [Convivia Cenarum Localia].

medalList.description:
You listened to the last piece of music performed by a certain someone.
Some have found peace, while others continue their search tirelessly.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Sanctilaminium Ambrosii] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
His Holiness has personally granted you a commendation for your service to the Curia.
You may choose any codename you like from the following: 'Mission Accomplisher,' 'Duty Harvester,' and 'Diligent Screwdriver.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Secretae Continere] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have personally repaired all of the monastery's damage.
Time has taken away its former glory, leaving naught but disarray. Even then, there are yet those who diligently maintain their home.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, repair Makeshift Walkways 50 times with Spare Timber.

medalList.description:
Thanks to your hard work, there are no more holes in the floor.
With all this repair work done, will everything be restored back to how it used to be?
medalList.getMethod: Clear HE-8 with a 3-star rating while repairing all Makeshift Walkways on the battlefield.

medalList.description:
You've quelled all the disputes within the monastery.
Everyone yearns for peace, friendship, and hope, but where should you begin the search?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Sacrarium Derelictum] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
Even in an intense battle, you did not forget to defend the faith.
Whether you are a believer or not, these statues have indeed served as encouragement and support to many.
medalList.getMethod: Clear HE-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with no Holy Statues destroyed.

medalList.description:
You have mastered how to soothe anxious minds.
You know why they are anxious. You have the answer to where they can find tranquility.
medalList.getMethod: Clear HE-EX-7 with a 3-star rating with Makeshift Walkways destroyed no more than 2 times.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who demonstrate outstanding aptitude in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The Sanctuary preserves your record in posterity.
medalList.getMethod: Reach a total Sanctuary Judgment score of 600 in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who demonstrate both intelligence and courage in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The Sanctuary recognizes your quality.
medalList.getMethod: Reach a best score of 100 in all 6 Sanctuary Judgment areas in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that comes with an outfit in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
The knight comes, chasing a dream.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain Tournament Fantasy Retrofit Kit in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all three test plates in Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Pinch-Out Experimental Operation.
medalList.getMethod: During Pinch-Out Experimental Operation, use Friend Support to clear any test 5 or more times.

medalList.description:
You saw true stars in the sky.
The sun rises again. May starlight ever be in your heart.

Her eyes are different when you see her again.
Some are obsessed with the past, others with the future. She is the bridge that connects them.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain Silence the Paradigmatic during Lone Trail.

medalList.description:
The Special Case Contact rates your contribution highly.
Columbia is willing to pay, if you are willing to work.
medalList.getMethod: During Lone Trail, spend 2400 Flight Data Recorder Chips in [Special Case Contact C.U.D.O.D.].

medalList.description: The one inevitable meaning that life ultimately seeks.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Coming of The Future] (including tutorials).

medalList.description:
You successfully completed all missions.
You have caught the eye of the Maylander Foundation. Columbia needs people like you.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Instruction Catalogue] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have gained a firm grasp on the application of gravity.
Director Nasti of Rhine Lab has taken an interest in you. She awaits your visit.
medalList.getMethod: Complete 2 secret zones.

medalList.description:
You have gotten the hang of changing gravity.
The experience will come in handy someday.
medalList.getMethod: During Lone Trail, trigger a total of 30 or more gravity changes in completed stages.

medalList.description:
The Tin Man thanks you for your help behind the scenes and gifts you this medal.
The conflict between the Maylander Foundation and the Department of Defense is in the past. The future belongs to Columbia.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Lingering of The Past] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
Medal awarded by the Department of Defense for completing all Special Ops.
You are aware that war has changed, and you must be ready.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Pursuing of the Present] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You understood that this act was not Kristen's alone.
She stands for countless dreams and aspirations.
medalList.getMethod: Complete investigation in any 2 zones in [Case Investigation] and claim the rewards.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal using the logo of a certain conceptual prototype as a blueprint.
The terminus of the commonplace and outdated, the starting point of a new paradigm.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Base Point.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.medalName: Base Point: Commemorative Contract Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Base Point.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal always worn during Operation Base Point.
There is no better way to get to know a loved one than to understand and support her preferences.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, exchange for the 'Fantastic Crafts' outfit.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Base Point.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.medalName: Base Point: Call to Arms Medal
medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Base Point.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.medalName: Base Point: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Base Point.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Base Point.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Base Point.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Base Point.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Base Point, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times.

medalList.description:
You have completed your journey in Yumen.
The wounded city comes to a temporary stop, as travelers set off on their journeys once more, with their newfound answers. It is not yet too late.

You come across an Anasa girl with pure eyes.
She does not understand her master's 'ideals,' but is willing to travel afar for them. Thus, a rock in the wilderness finds itself tumbling into a nomadic city.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow' event, obtain Operator Jieyun.

medalList.medalName: New Customer At Old Workshop Medal
medalList.description:
You witnessed the Sword Forge's craftsmen forge weapons and collected a great number of fine treasures.
Though old friends have departed, new blades must yet be forged, for the jianghu yet remains.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow' event, consume 2400 Newly-Distilled Liedaozi in [Sword Forge].

medalList.description:
You have successfully locked down the Shanhaizhong that infiltrated the city.
Those who have grown used to the poplars are familiar with every breeze and every grain of sand.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Case Investigation, Onsite] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You have made a name for yourself on the long-standing Yumen Arena Board of Fame.
Having your name on the board is like having wine when you are happy; it is merely a compliment to your joy. Every man has a responsibility to defend their homeland.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Yumen Arena Board of Fame] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have exposed Its background and uncovered Its purpose.
Anger, bewilderment, humiliation... countless subtle emotions fade away in fleeting moments, yet they exist in this ceaseless, eternal moment.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WB-9 with a 3-star rating and defeat 'Ya' while Delusion is active.

medalList.description:
Your contributions to the Patrol Battalion's deployment have been immense, filling all around you with admiration.
There is traditional saying in the Yumen army: 'There are a wealth of young men practicing kung fu in Yumen, and they are not as tall as the wooden stake when they first start practicing.'
medalList.getMethod: Clear WB-EX-1 with a 3-star rating with at least 3 'Roadblocks' remaining on the battlefield.

medalList.description: You have finished reading Heroes of Yumen and have discovered the true chaos both within and outside of the story. Turbulent winds and clouds grow old as those who come continue to pursue. Keeping my difficulties quiet, my heart remains steadfast.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Criminal Pursuit, Offsite] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
Your performance before the Yumen army has greatly roused all those in attendance.
Hear the winds beating the drums, the rattling of the sheathes, and the songs of triumph.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WB-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with no more than 1 Shanhaizhong Cipher Machine remaining on the battlefield.

medalList.description:
You recorded the poem the poet composed in the face of Catastrophe.
'All of Heaven and earth in a flask. That long dream, tragic ere and now.'
medalList.getMethod: Clear WB-EX-4 with a 3-star rating with no more than 2 Shanhaizhong Harbingers having climbed onto the Yumen Catastrophe Defenses.

medalList.description:
You saw a flame burn peacefully.
Whether the path up ahead is treacherous or smooth, everything is now crystal clear.

You have drawn the attention of an intelligence agent.
He is calm and collected in his observations. Only mere moments later, an endless stream of threads and connections have already been pieced together in his mind.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'What the Firelight Casts' event, obtain Operator Puzzle.

medalList.description:
The folksong manuscripts you transcribed follow the caravan's footsteps and are being carried further afield.
You truly believe that one day, they will be brought to more vibrant, thriving lands, where they will again be sung loud and clear.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'What the Firelight Casts' event, consume 2400 'Manuscripts of Ballads' in [River Valley Caravan].

medalList.description:
You set foot into ruins that have long been forgotten.
The winds howled through the eroded caves, producing a terrifying roar that, to your ears, are like an elegy sung by throats weathered by history.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Swamp In The Mists] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages).

medalList.description:
You went through a night that was shrouded in dense, thick smoke.
As you lift your head up, you see a flame scorching the dark night sky and leaving behind but the blood-colored scar we call 'dawn.'
medalList.getMethod: Clear FC-6 with a 3-star rating without any ignited Reeds

medalList.description:
Your emotions stirred upon hearing her voice.
You find it hard to distinguish whether those words that touched you heart carried hope or ambition.
medalList.getMethod: Clear FC-8 with a 3-star rating with operators deployed in Mire no more than 3 times.

medalList.description:
After much pondering, you decided to present the truth.
What lies in the boundary between truth and falsehood is not an impassable chasm, but rather a tiny idea.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Search Warrant From the City Council] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You swept away the shadows that shrouded memories.
She is no longer someone else's shadow.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Ashes of Memories] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You carefully followed her and avoided the fatal quagmires.
A slanting beam of sunlight falls upon the murky, frigid mire, igniting a spark of hope in you.
medalList.getMethod: Clear FC-EX-7 with a 3-star rating with operators deployed in Mire no more than 3 times.

medalList.description:
After the inferno, you found a patch of land where life yet blooms.
The bitter fruits sown anew have experienced war and exile, yet they remain prepared to break through the soil to see tomorrow's daylight.
medalList.getMethod: Clear FC-EX-8 with a 3-star rating with at least 3 unignited Reeds.

medalList.description:
You completed your journey at Siracusa.
Remember to visit the graves and offer fresh flowers before you leave.

You forget yourself among the operas.
The facade of happiness is fleeting. The truth of pain is eternal.
medalList.getMethod: Give 10 Likes in Critica Artistica during IL Siracusano

medalList.description:
You know the heir of Bellone. Ah, the famiglia formerly known as Bellone.
The wolf cub picks up his father's banner in his mouth and runs towards the moon in his heart, casting away stale and rotten order.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain Vigil during IL Siracusano

medalList.description:
Supplies that you purchased have filled the famiglia's warehouse.
Fresh ingredients pile up, and the goods furthest in have unusually long expiration dates.
medalList.getMethod: Spend 1800 Permesso di Importazione during IL Siracusano

medalList.description:
You have tried everything on the menu.
The steak's bloody cross-section leaves a deep impression, but the taste is okay overall.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Menù del Banchetto] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You witnessed change in Siracusa.
Old thorns buried deep within flesh have been shifted. What lies at the end of the path of briars is yet unknown, yet some continue to tread that path.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Stagione delle Piogge] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You have reached the end of this rain.
A gap opens in the overcast sky. The wind blowing in from the barrens stops in its steps. Passersby look up, waiting for the next rain by habit.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Pistole e Ordine] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You seized the throat of the Lord of the Wilds.
The rules of the game may not be broken.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Pistole e Ordine] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You watched the final act of I Siracusani.
Familiar actors leave the stage one by one, and the heavy curtain drops down. A new city awaits the dawn of day.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Terra Desolata Autoproclamata] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
Your name has become known amongst the famiglie.
Be careful at night.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all tasks for 7 characters during IL Siracusano.

medalList.description:
You cast your gaze over the streets of Volsinii.
Not even the tiniest speck of blood by the sewer entrances escapes your attention.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all areas in Volsinii during IL Siracusano.

medalList.description:
Medal created by Closure, developer of the Trials for Navigator.
Real or virtual, she will always be your guide in times of danger.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock limiter units [Reuse Modules], [High-Speed Memory] and [Repel Control].

medalList.description:
Medal made in the image of a navigator greeting the rays of dawn on the deck of Rhodes Island.
One trial does not make a navigator, but your fearlessness has impressed everyone.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Clash of Ideologies.

medalList.description:
A medal personally crafted by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure.
No matter what kind of trials you will face, she will always be on your side.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock limiter units [Maintenance Patch], [Reduction Module] and [Optimize Load].

medalList.description:
A medal made in the image of a navigator pulling an all-nighter in the offices of Rhodes Island.
The contents of the trials are everchanging, and your unmovable persistence fills all around you with great admiration.
medalList.getMethod: Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Proud Sun's Shadow.

medalList.description:
Your knowledge of the ins and outs of Zeruertza is on par with the natives.
'You may be a little tall, but it's not like we don't have tall citizens!'

You see a new operator being dragged along by Gavial.
He has spent many years in the world of design, but his career as a designer is only just begun.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain Minimalist during Ideal City: Endless Carnival.

medalList.description:
The overprinted magazine copies almost buried the Leaping Gloompincer Market.
The representatives of Zeruertza secretly discussed whether to make copies of it the official currency of Zeruertza. Fortunately, none of them were drunk at the time.
medalList.getMethod: Spend 2400 Photocopies of 'Stranger Things' in [Leaping Gloompincer Market] during Ideal City: Endless Carnival.

medalList.description:
You completed most of the missions at the City Forum.
The Durin have never seen someone so industrious. They would have asked more from you, if they weren't about to evacuate.
medalList.getMethod: Complete any 40 missions in [City Forum] and claim the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have collected countless pieces of self-driving cart gear.
You are collecting faster than the makers can produce new ones, and meeting your growing needs has become a major challenge for suppliers.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain 20 pieces of Self-Driving Cart gear during Ideal City: Endless Carnival.

medalList.description:
You bore witness to a journey that went beneath the surface, then back to the surface again.
The carnival will continue even at Acahualla. It is hot there, after all.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Underground Sightseeing] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You experienced Durin culture, which is very different from life on the surface.
It is not such a bad way of life, but there are few who have chosen to become part of it.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Cultural Shock] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You know the culture and lifestyle of the Durin of Zeruertza like the palm of your hand.
Never forget, however, that Zeruertza is merely one of many Durin city-states.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Cultural Shock] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You ensured that the elevator safely brought the denizens of Zeruertza to Acahualla.
It is no small feat to transport the entire population of a city, especially since almost all of them are Durin.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Elevator Maintenance] on Challenge Mode (except IC-MO-1).

medalList.description:
You reached the pinnacle of Zeruertza's celebrations.
You've defeated all opponents on the Self-Driver Hell Trail, becoming a legend of Zeruertza.
medalList.getMethod: Complete IC-MO-1 in [Elevator Maintenance] with a 3-star rating.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the image of those drowning in waves of money.
The last gasps of air that they willingly exhale from their drowning lungs are the final sounds of the waves.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Fake Waves.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.medalName: Fake Waves: Commemorative Contract Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Fake Waves.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded when you obtain a certain outfit in Operation Fake Waves.
New spring, new scenes.
medalList.getMethod: Exchange for outfit 'Afternoon Teatime' in Operation Fake Waves.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Fake Waves.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.medalName: Fake Waves: Call to Arms Medal
medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Fake Waves.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.medalName: Fake Waves: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Fake Waves.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Fake Waves.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Fake Waves.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Fake Waves.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Fake Waves, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on a foxhole and charred corpse motif.
The impact of war reaches to the bone. There is no place for flesh and blood to hide.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Ashring.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Ashring.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded when you obtain a certain outfit.
Good health is the starting point of everything.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, exchange for the outfit 'Rest Between Sets.'

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Ashring.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Ashring.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.medalName: Ashring: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Ashring.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Ashring.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Ashring.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Ashring.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Ashring, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times.

medalList.medalName: 'You Have to Wake Up in the End'
medalList.description:
You have seen this journey at Trimounts through to the end.
The site is now a ruin due to out-of-control tech, but behind the curtain will forever be an undying force to prop it back up. You need to take care around technology, and be on guard against the powers behind it.

You have defeated a new model of never-before-seen weapon.
When something out of the ordinary is discovered, there's usually a complete system in place behind it.
medalList.getMethod: Clear DV-5 with a 3-star rating while defeating at least 1 R-31 Heavy Power Armor.

medalList.description:
The first medal Astgenne received upon arriving at Rhodes Island.
If she's determined to break away from something, then she sure will. Life puts shackles on her that defy description, and she can only cut her fetters away and continue on.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dorothy's Vision' event, obtain Operator Astgenne.

medalList.description:
You have experienced a day in the life of the typical Rhine Lab worker.
Running up data and getting results are hard enough as is, but your boss always saddles you with unimaginable inspection deadlines. You're lucky not to be crushed with debt, at least.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dorothy's Vision' event, spend a total of 2,400 Mysterious Reagents at the [Laboratory Recycling Depot].

medalList.description:
You have flawlessly handled all aspects of your work experience.
Rhine personnel tell you that this is the simplest a day gets in their lives, workload included. You have decided to leave this place as soon as you can, to return to the office you know so well.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Data Collection] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have witnessed the shattering of a wonderful vision.
What broke this beautiful dream was not cruel reality, but the dreamer herself waking up and coming to. She doesn't wish to tie down those she loves—she wants to send them off to futures further flung.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Test Site] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials, DV-S-1 and DV-S-2).

medalList.description:
You have made it to the pinnacle in your challenge against technology.
Tech ought to be a helping hand in humanity's advance, not a hindrance, but people always seem to love exploiting it for strife.
medalList.getMethod: Clear DV-EX-2 with a 3-star rating while activating at least 3 R-31a Heavy Power Armors.

medalList.description:
You do not consider Dorothy the true enemy by any means.
She founded a dreamland to fulfill her ideals, and destroyed that dreamland to prove her ideals.
medalList.getMethod: Clear DV-EX-7 with a 3-star rating without defeating Dorothy.

medalList.description:
You have seen the rainclouds drifting over Trimounts.
At the end of the wilds lies hope and opportunity, along with danger and misfortune.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Rhine HQ] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You have a staunch will, never perturbed by false visions, no matter how beautiful.
Some might choose to find blessings in falsehood. You have planted your feet in reality and testified to your standpoint.
medalList.getMethod: Clear DV-8 with a 3-star rating, with 'Awaken' defeating no more than 2 friendly Operators with [Journey] while alive.

medalList.description:
You have analyzed various information about the Afterglow and come to a decision. 
Those who hide their faces are still preparing to make their move, but your actions have nevertheless saved many innocent lives.

You have taken full advantage of the energy emanating from underground. 
The schemers never expected the aging power lines to obstruct their own.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Lingering Echoes' event, deploy Operators in Realigned Flux a total of 200 times.

medalList.description:
You have provided financial support for an abject musician. 
He understands the preciousness of wealth, but is far more willing to give up everything for someone who understands the value of art.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Lingering Echoes' event, obtain Operator Czerny.

medalList.description:
You have found a large amount of lost drafts, and have sent them to the musician. 
A new melody is forming within his mind. He decides to gift it to whoever sends the most manuscripts.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Lingering Echoes' event, spend 2400 Draft Sheet Music in [Musician's Mailbox].

medalList.description:
You have sampled every kind of coffee available in the Afterglow. 
For various reasons, the shopkeeper is often away for long periods, but the coffee's taste remains the same.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Spy Base] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have witnessed a concert that leaves a lasting impression. 
Please leave the venue quietly and do not disturb the long shadows left on the ground by the sunset.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Afterglow Hall] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You have rectified the misconceptions of a few prideful people. 
Do not underestimate percussion instruments. Setting aside the timpani, which is often considered the vice-conductor of the orchestra, the humble triangle comes with its own wealth of techniques.
medalList.getMethod: Clear LE-EX-3 with a 3-star rating, and have 9 Operators in Realigned Flux at the time of victory.

medalList.description:
You have precisely identified the opponent's tactics and swiftly defeated them. 
Talent is important, but daily practice and patience are just as much so.
medalList.getMethod: Clear LE-EX-7 with a 3-star rating, and have none of Dame Gertrude's Virtual Images on the field at the time of victory.

medalList.description:
You know the alleyways of the Afterglow like the back of your hand. 
The sunset will not stay forever, and the long night will inevitably come to an end.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Back Alleys] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You have withstood the pressure that comes with the roar of the past. 
Not many can stand unflinching in the face of the nothingness that threatens to consume all meaning, but you are one of those few.
medalList.getMethod: Clear LE-8 with a 3-star rating, and have no more than 3 Operators leave the field during 'Lamentation of Nothingness.'

medalList.description:
An engraved medal made to capture the impression of the ocean waves crashing upon the coast.
The tides forever ebb and flood in a never-ending cycle. This is the sea's silence and the sea's roar.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Deepness.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Deepness.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal proving your recruitment of an Operator during Operation Deepness.
Her harp serenades the beauty of the lands, while her bow protects it all. The two complement one another.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, obtain Operator Erato.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Deepness.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Deepness.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.medalName: Deepness: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Deepness.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Deepness.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Deepness.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Deepness.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Deepness, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times.

medalList.description:
You have completed your journey at Gran Faro.
The waves yet beat against the rocks on the shore. This brief moment of tranquil will not be the end, yet there will always be someone standing watch here like a lighthouse. As long as a ray of light still shines, the eternal night will never arrive.

You have a firm grasp of many technologies from the past.
Technology and the future go hand in hand with one another, but sometimes you can learn something new by looking at the past.
medalList.getMethod: Activate all of 'Little Handy's' components.

medalList.description:
A medal that Thiago awarded Jordi many years ago.
When he received this commendation for getting the church sparkling clean, he never would have imagined that he would one day shine light upon Iberia's seas.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Stultifera Navis' event, obtain Operator Lumen.

medalList.description:
Your spending power has left a deep impression on the townsfolk here.
Iberian souvenirs may seem cheap to foreign visitors, but this would perhaps have been unimaginable before the Profound Silence.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Stultifera Navis' event, spend a total of 2,400 Rusted Compasses at [Bitterscale Tavern].

medalList.medalName: Treasures of the Raging Seas Medal
medalList.description:
You found many lost treasures.
Perhaps these treasures never belonged to anyone to begin with, and the ocean bestows them upon those who have its approval.
medalList.getMethod: Obtain all Treasure Chest rewards on the map.

medalList.description:
You witnessed the sinking of the Stultifera Navis.
The destination of a ship is not necessarily a port. It could be an ideal instead.
It was the final witness to a glorious age, and in turn, you are its.
medalList.getMethod: Clear all story stages (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You used a small number of tools to excellent advantage.
Putting tools to good use is not the same as being dependent on them, a fact often forgotten throughout the course of civilization.
medalList.getMethod: Clear SN-EX-5 with a 3-star rating while equipping at most 3 'Little Handy' components.

medalList.description:
You laid down judgment on the invaders from the seas.
This is a world built atop the principle of natural selection.
Having proven yourself the stronger, you have earned the right to lay down judgment.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Dusty Picturebook] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You set foot on the beach after the tides have ebbed.
At the end of the billowing waves, will we find dry, arid lands or a calm sea?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Mirror Image] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You defeated your adversary under extremely perilous conditions.
Man created tools to make up for his weakness, yet you chose to set them aside to prove your strength.
Simply claiming victory is not enough. Perhaps this is what you truly wanted instead?
medalList.getMethod: Clear SN-EX-8 with a 3-star rating while equipping at most 3 'Little Handy' components.

medalList.description:
You have visited, and left Laterano.
That this holy city has never collapsed amidst crisis is owed to its faith, just as you have always held firm to your own beliefs. Your gait ceases not, so where's the harm in being astray?

You have had a deep discussion with the Pathfinders.
