They question, they quest. They are the lost, yet so too the steady seekers of the way.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GA-7 while defeating the Pathfinder Nuncio.

medalList.description:
A handmade medal gifted to Ezell by the Notarial Hall's seasoned ranks.
The moment he began to follow his own heart, unfettered by what had set in as common sense, was when he qualified as a true executor.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Guide Ahead' event, obtain Operator Enforcer.

medalList.description:
You have let the money flow during the Summit of Nations.
The Nuncios have informed you that every guest at the conference will be received with courtesy, and that you may enjoy your time in Laterano without worrying about expenditures. You've taken the chance to thoroughly appreciate this holy city.
medalList.getMethod: During the ‘Guide Ahead' event, spend a total of 2,400 Etched Bullet Casings at [Lateranian Desserts].

medalList.description:
You have perfectly handled a great number of affairs during the Summit of Nations.
Transfer of relics, upholding order... Your experiences as a Notarial Hall executor have been far from interesting, and whether you can keep it up hinges on how committed you are to 'the faith and the law.'
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Notarial Tasks] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You have finally voiced the doubts buried deep in your heart, and found an answer.
In truth, you didn't need anyone's reply. You needed only to ask the question: in asking, you more truly interrogated yourself. About what you hear and believe, about what you gain and lose, about the path you've walked and your way forward.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Summit of Nations] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You have borne witness to multiple counts of demolition on Laterano's streets.
Within the scope permitted by the commandments and the code, every Lateran has the right to satisfy their curiosity, including by demolition of buildings... You've needed some mental gymnastics to comprehend this.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GA-EX-2 with a 3-star rating without enemies (Pathfinder Ballistarii Prefect) using 'Gelato Stop' to replenish ammo.

medalList.description:
You have taken in a series of events from Iberia's past.
He ran a long, long way, ultimately coming against a tremendous wall. He wanted to know why this towering wall was erected here, and so heartlessly.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GA-EX-5 with a 3-star rating, and control 2 'Gelato Stops' at time of victory.

medalList.description:
You have heard the bells of the Tower of Revelations.
'The bells echoed throughout the wilderness, uniting all the Sankta.' But you know it was someone up there singing a folksong, one that transcended time, one of parting.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Road to the Shrine] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You have obtained all usage rights for the 'Gelato Stops.'
Laterano's desserts have you reluctant to leave. Law makes this city stronger, and dessert makes it truer.
medalList.getMethod: Clear GA-EX-7 with a 3-star rating, and control 3 'Gelato Stops' at time of victory.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal fashioned after the torch that burned alone in the wilderness, enduring and bright.
The way is far and the night is long. Stand no vain vigil for dawn at hand; light instead the path ahead, and be swift through the starry dark.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Dawnseeker.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Dawnseeker.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal bundled with an outfit obtained from Operation Dawnseeker.
Adventure is a lonely undertaking, and music is the ultimate pastime. Don't show too much surprise at Asbestos's musical tastes, now.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, exchange for the outfit 'Glen Sonata'

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Dawnseeker.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles, making effective use of the terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Dawnseeker.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.medalName: Dawnseeker: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Dawnseeker.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Dawnseeker.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Dawnseeker.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Dawnseeker.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Dawnseeker, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times.

medalList.description:
You've managed to find the owner of the goblet. 
What is inherent to us, as well as to the fate of this land, are unanswerable questions by nature. Anger is useless, fear is unnecessary, so we might as well drink, sing, and keep our minds and hearts open.

You are already familiar with Shancheng's unique geography. 
As the saying goes, you've walked the 'Trials of Shu's Paths'. Cableways and tunnels connect the mountains, and the mountains are integrated into the city. Highs and lows intertwine like a maze, yet the Shangshu people never get lost. And you have already become half Shangshu yourself.
medalList.getMethod: Clear IW-4 while defeating at least 15 Wooden Waregeists (including Grindstone, Vernacularism, and Inkwave).

medalList.description: 'Once you raise your crossbow, the only things left swimming in your eyes are your sight and your target. But before you pull the trigger, there's so much you've got to think about.' The crossbow is not only a weapon, and the relationship between the tip of the bolt and the target is much more complicated. To contemplate this means that you have grown.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Invitation to Wine' event, obtain Operator Kroos the Keen Glint.

medalList.description:
You are generous when paying for tea and wine. 
The scenery in Shangshu differs from any other. With time to spare, you can climb mountains and marvel at the boulders. Without, you can enjoy tea and sample wine. You are extravagant and carefree, and have become well acquainted with the various shopkeepers.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Invitation to Wine' event, spend a total of 2,400 Canned Tea at [Xingyu Inn].

medalList.description:
You've left your footprints across the peaks of Shangshu. 
The old shops at the foot of the mountains, the porters coming and going, the timeless pavilions, the new wines, and the countless legends of the ancients scattered throughout the mountains will always live on.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Escort Duty] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
The incidents you've encountered in Shangshu have all subsided. 
But beyond Shangshu, the trend continues. It is impossible for you to stay on the sidelines, so you might as well buy some wine first.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Tales of Three-Mountains] with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You've imbibed several jugs of Husong wine without getting drunk. 
This wine is a Shangshu specialty, different from Jiangnan's light wine and Saibei's strong wine in that its flavor lingers longer. You are a decent drinker, and those cups that seem to fly in and prance away are no drunkard's illusion.
medalList.getMethod: Clear IW-EX-4 while defeating at least 5 Porcelain Waregeists (Scarletmist).

medalList.description:
You've brought new changes to Shancheng's time-honored brand. 
Escort businesses, guest inns... There are always things that have withstood the tides of societal change. But rules are destroyed and birthed anew in an endless cycle. Whether they are now broken or still standing is not always an easy question to answer.
medalList.getMethod: Clear IW-EX-6 while defeating at least 5 Metal Waregeists (Including Sharpedge, Scantwords).

medalList.description:
You've reached the summit spoken of in legends. 
When you stood atop the eighteenth peak of Shangshu which was said to not exist, only then did you realize the legendary Catastrophe actually occurred. Every saying, every legend, is but another of the city's masks. Though a mask may change one's appearance, flesh and blood lies just underneath—and that itself is a form of truth.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Mountain Top] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You finally faced Sui-Xiang. 
All those roars that you heard spanning the millennia may have been anger, fear, or, in the end, nothing more than your own obsessions.
medalList.getMethod: Clear IW-EX-8 with a 3-star rating while defeating no more than 50 Wisps.

medalList.description:
You stopped the avalanche. 
The winter sunlight pours across the land of Kjerag, laughter fills the air, and everything seems to be developing in a better direction. However, as you know well, the snow will continue to fall, and avalanches... will happen again and again.

You are a true master of snowfield combat tactics. 
The purpose of training each Tschäggättä team was to realize your goals. And obviously, you still have some energy left.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BI-8 with a 3-star rating before the second blizzard arrives.

medalList.description:
You have gained Her favor. 
God does not exist, but God also does exist. When She looks across Her dominion, not a soul knows whether She will be proud or bewildered.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Break the Ice' event, obtain Operator Kjera.

medalList.description:
You've become a VIP of the Karlan Trade Company. 
Even without being personal friends with Enciodes, the vast amount of money you spent at the Kjerag Exchange is enough to get premium suites at Karlan. You might even consider trying to compete with Enciodes, which may not be a bad option either.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Break the Ice' event, spend a total of 2,400 Stones of Kjeragandr at [Turicam Trade Zone].

medalList.description:
You've walked the streets and alleyways of Kjerag. 
You've discovered that modern technology has gradually spread through this small country, and perhaps by your next visit, the entire country will be transformed. Whether that's a good or a bad thing, you can't say for sure.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Kjerag Guidebook] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
Your trip to Kjerag took an unexpected turn. 
Or perhaps, that was what you expected all along?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Grand Ceremony] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You've learned some tricks from the hunters who live in isolation in the mountains.
Snow conceals many things—conspiracies, bloodstains, and of course... traps.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BI-5 while making at least 3 Icefield Arts Fighter fall.

medalList.description:
Your prestige has spread to every corner of Kjerag. 
The people believe that none are worthier to serve as Enciodes's right hand than you, and as both you and Enciodes know, you both are looking forward to your next contest.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Holy Hunt] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You succeeded in containing Degenbrecher. 
An army of one holds ten-thousand at the pass. You should be thankful that she isn't your enemy after all.
medalList.getMethod: Clear BI-EX-8 and defeat Degenbrecher.

medalList.description:
Your ability to toy with your prey upon the snowfield is an artform. 
Under your guidance, they may even believe that they chose to walk into your trap, and that you are a mere bystander.

An engraved medal based on the cast of a legendary artist's seal.

As the saying goes, you don't reach out to slap the face of a smiling man. If you want medical attention from Aak, you'd do well to watch your manners.

medalList.description:
You witnessed one knight seize triumph twice, but this time, she left her laurels on the podium. 
At the end of the long night, the sun rises over the horizon. Before it sets, her blazing light will spread across the entire land.

A badge Iwona designed for herself back when she was still a competition knight. 
The reason most people remember her badge is not for its actual design, but rather its golden luster.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Near Light' event, obtain Operator Wild Mane.

medalList.description:
You experienced the 'leisure' life of a Kazimierzian public official. 
For all that is holy, you're grateful that the tasks they assigned you were limited in scope, and that you didn't have to attend any meetings.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Near Light' event, complete all Long-Term Goals for all factions in 'Your Desk.'

medalList.description:
You poured a tremendous amount of effort in securing the support of various organizations. 
Amazed by your business prowess, career bureaucrats are ready to weave your feats into management textbooks.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Near Light' event, spend a total of 20 Agenda Proposals when completing Daily Tasks in 'Your Desk.'

medalList.description:
You've reached an agreement with Kazimierz's leadership. 
As you know, the maintenance of this relationship is completely dependent on the principles of consistent mutual benefit and profit maximization.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Near Light' event, raise your Prestige with any of the three major factions to [Respected].

medalList.description:
You've spent some time at Kazimierz's Trade Exhibition. 
Here, the merchandise is not only duty free, but many special discounts are available during the event. As attractive an opportunity as this is for buyers, companies are more than glad for the opportunity to dump their wares.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Near Light' event, spend a total of 2,400 G.K.T. Commemorative Models at 'Trade Exhibition.'

medalList.description:
You witnessed a champion of the Kazimierz Major being crowned again. 
As usual, the 24th Major Championship Medal Set will be released for a limited time only and will soon enter the market, becoming another hot piece in the medal collection scene.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in 'Kawalerielki' with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You've experienced the fulfilling life of a Red Wine reporter. 
Writing a report is like cooking a dish - it depends not only on the raw ingredients, but also on whether the master's craftsmanship is pure.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in 'Area 0' with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You've learned the tricks of the trade to being an entertainment reporter. 
The headlines should be huge, the photos should be blurry. The content should be funky, and the text should be brief.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in 'Area 0' on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You've visited the Alliance's main locations. 
Though the Grand Knight Territory boasts few formal military units, the individual combat abilities of these knights still impress you.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in 'City Neon' with 3-star ratings.

medalList.description:
You've participated in an invitational tournament co-hosted by the Alliance.
Few people can beat these pros under the competition's rules, and regardless of the outcome, they're the ones who always stand to reap the benefits.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in 'City Neon' on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on a wild beast's scales.
One can only imagine how many have found themselves ensnared by the beauty of this lone wild scale.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Wild Scales.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Wild Scales, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site

medalList.medalName: Wild Scales: Commemorative Contract Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Wild Scales.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Wild Scales, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site

medalList.description:
An engraved medal comes with the outfit in Operation Wild Scales.
Trust me! She really is just here to do first aid!

medalList.description:
Entertainment is everything!
Enjoy yourself with all you've got. That's the meaning of life!

A badge that Pancho always kept on him; it is now Ernesto's.
Although what the badge once stood for has long ceased to be, Ernesto continues to keep it on him at all times. We shall never know whether this is meant to be a keepsake or a way for him to reflect on himself.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, obtain Operator Tequila.

medalList.description:
You now know what Ch'en has been up to aside from participating in the competition while she is on holiday in Dossoles.
This has been a terrible holiday to her. Well, maybe not as bad as she's making it sound.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, complete all of [Ch'en's Clue Note]'s content.

medalList.description:
Thank you for your contributions you have made to the promotion of Dossoles's cityscapes.
The Lungmenites have really taken spotlight here. Perhaps you should take a few more photos with them while they're around.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, collect all [Honors Showcase] photographs.

medalList.description:
You have had quite the shopping spree at Mama John's.
The merchandise you purchased will be delivered to your hotel in Dossoles. May I assist you any other way?
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, spend 4,000 Mama John's Vouchers at [Mama John's].

medalList.description:
You have witnessed Team LUNG wRATh's taking the gold in the competition.
Although much of the prize money has been withheld to make up for all the sunk boats, the remainder of the money should still be enough for the team to enjoy the rest of their time in Dossoles.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Dossoles Warrior Champion] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You have begun to really 'understand' what Dossoles stands for. It is a city full of 'opportunities.'
If you make a name for yourself here, someone is bound to knock on your door. Taking care of the trouble will get you even more famous. What a vicious cycle.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Afterwinds] with 3-star ratings

medalList.description:
You have certainly found your place here in Dossoles.
The only way to break this cycle is by proving that you are strong enough, and you have done it.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Afterwinds] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
Ch'en and the gang battled it out with the delinquents that fled to Dossoles.
Oni and Tiger Twinned Stars; Mouse's Courage, Dragon's Might.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all Special Investigation stages in [Tidings Unseen] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
With the help of Rhodes Island's field operators, Ch'en and her friends captured a group of diehard remnants of Pancho's gang.
From here on out, the L.G.D.'s name will forever hang over the heads of all Dossoles criminals.
medalList.getMethod: Complete DH-MO-1 in [Tidings Unseen] with a 3-star rating

medalList.description:
Ch'en and Lin Yühsia can now claim to be big Dossoles collectors.
Of course, as everyone knows, most people become so-called collectors when they have nothing better to do. That's how it usually goes in Dossoles, at least.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, collect all Stickers

medalList.description:
Unfortunate, or just bored. Ch'en and Lin Yühsia may have to pick one of these titles for themselves.
Ernesto spent all night forging this medal. The look on his face when he handed Ch'en the medal revealed that not even he could have foreseen this outcome.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Dossoles Holiday' event, obtain 5 gifts from Ernesto at recycling

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on the coat of arms of a certain knight family.
Its champion has finally fallen silent, and the knight follows suit.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Spectrum.

You have overcome many challenges.

Are you ready to get moving?

medalList.description:
You spent a few days in this deceased city.
To be able to leave was already fortuitous. Are you sure you want to return?

You worked hard to restart emergency aid buildings throughout the city.
Is it too late? Nobody knows.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Under Tides' event, activate Emergency Aid Buildings a total of 50 times (excluding tutorials).

medalList.medalName: 'Three Hunters Are Walking on Seacoast Way'
medalList.description:
You heard their song.
Should Gladiia not will it, even the most sophisticated recording equipment cannot capture these special vibrations.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Under Tides' event, obtain Operator Gladiia.

medalList.description:
You collected a large number of records from the ruins.
They cannot fill your belly nor can they make a sound, but music still fills your head.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'Under Tides' event, spend a total of 2,400 Corrupted Iberian Records at the [Barter].

medalList.description:
You endured hunger that most cannot bear.
This may allow you to hold on a bit longer, but you'll still need to find food as quickly as possible.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Try to Survive] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You've caught a glimpse of the shadows flowing beneath the tide.
It is but the tip of the iceberg. Your sanity has so far withstood this test.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Deserted Salviento] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You faced claws and fangs that do not exist upon this land.
You've learned that emergency facilities can temporarily relieve the pain wracking your brain, but you are hesitant to rely on it.
medalList.getMethod: Clear SV-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while activating Emergency Aid Buildings no more than 1 time.

medalList.description:
You have already given enough.
The challenges that lie ahead may defy your wildest imagination. Pray that you will survive until the very end.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Choppy Ruin] on Challenge Mode.

medalList.description:
You've discovered the unexpected temptation of giving up.
The utility of the emergency facilities is declining. Is that because they are changing, or is it because of you?
medalList.getMethod: Clear SV-EX-7 with a 3-star rating without activating an Emergency Aid Building.

medalList.description:
You fully understood the appeal of those words.
Your nerves have been thrashed raw, but your spirit remains indomitable. Finally, you have realized that it is not technology that can sway a believer, but rather the conviction of a soul that believes in itself.
medalList.getMethod: Clear SV-9 with a 3-star rating while activating Emergency Aid Buildings no more than 1 time.

medalList.description:
You have witnessed a very small portion of her tortuous journey.
Inscribed within her eyes are a great land and an entire epoch. Just as we cannot condense the rise and fall of civilizations in a single word, we scarcely have the words to describe her.

You cleverly handled the mercenary offensive.
Similar three-dimensional warfare solutions are expensive, and many mercenary companies find that annual drone expenditures are their most pressing problem.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'A Walk in the Dust' event, destroy a total of 50 Air Support Drones (includes Scrap, Scrap Model-U, Anvil, and Anvil Model-B, tutorial stages do not count).

medalList.description:
Heavyrain is coming.
Though she may look like a weak and timid girl, the weapon in her hand will sometimes move faster than her thoughts.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'A Walk in the Dust' event, obtain Operator Heavyrain.

medalList.description:
You've carefully sorted out old files for a certain operator. Will she thank you?
The knowledge and lost images within may not be the most memorable, but even through these fragments, you can feel a hint of a lonely romance and a noble mission.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'A Walk in the Dust' event, spend at least 2,400 Scattered Sketches in the Reefsteep Black Market.

medalList.description:
You've heard many anecdotes about her.
She's getting closer to becoming a flesh-and-blood 'human.' Only this way can she find her final destination.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Song of Dust] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You've watched her travel down many paths.
These are but small threads in the lengthy tapestry of civilization.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Walk Alone] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

medalList.description:
You've displayed excellence in neutralizing enemy drones.
Mercenaries hate fighting those who insist on shooting down their drones more than anything else. It gets too expensive.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WD-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while destroying at least 8 Air Support Drones (includes Scrap, Scrap Model-U, Anvil, and Anvil Model-B).

medalList.description:
You watched over her, and she watched over the land.
In this lifetime, she tried repeatedly to prevent humans from ushering in their own ruination. But her power is too diffuse, and she requires true followers.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [The Endless Road] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You've recovered a fair number of air support drones.
'Why break 'em? Think about how much money we save by waiting for them to run out of fuel, then picking 'em up.'
medalList.getMethod: Clear WD-EX-5 with a 3-star rating without destroying any Air Support Drones (includes Scrap, Scrap Model-U, Anvil, and Anvil Model-B).

medalList.description:
You tried your hardest to avoid getting entangled in foreign affairs.
The Dominion of Demons has long been a fanciful notion, having nothing to do the traces of any existing civilization, its principles inscrutable to any Arts or scientific research. However, it is by no means the only unknown existence in this world. After all, what do the civilizations of Terra have to show for all their development?
medalList.getMethod: Clear WD-8 with at least a 3-star rating while being hit by [Collapsing Fear] in [Dominion] no more than 4 times.

medalList.description:
You sensed through to Dusk's field of view.
Once, she said she was merely a habitant of a painting. Perhaps she truly landed her guess. But she doesn't plan on doing anything about it. What about you, then?

You made your first delve into Dusk's way of the painting.
The next time you meet, she'll bring you aesthetics from a place far above logic.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, deploy allied units on Marks of Hui and Ming a total of 150 times.

medalList.description:
From that home in a memory, you departed.
This place's customs, clothing and buildings were wholly unlike the nomadic cities of Yan in style. Was it someone's faint recollection of their hometown, or a phantasmagoria brought about by the wielder of a brush?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Leave From Yourself] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You avoided all possible excess reliance on Nian's items. This is very wise.
Heaven knows what's inside one of these two-step firecrackers, but it's not a normal Originium explosive at any rate. There's never anything wrong with using a little care.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WR-10 with a 3-star rating while using [Two-Step Firecracker mk2] less than 4 times

medalList.description:
You used appropriate obstructions to put the Ink Spirits to the test.
It has to be said, if some of the Ink Spirits truly existed in reality, it'd be a chance to change up the presently high-risk, high-barred state of the Originium Slug pet market.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WR-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while deploying Roadblocks less than 8 times

medalList.description:
You turned a blind eye as it broke its own shackles. This was your mercy.
'Free' had never been truly free to be before, and had actually rarely experienced situations like this. For a moment, it even sympathized with you.
medalList.getMethod: Clear WR-EX-8 with a 3-star rating without destroying [Free]'s barrier [Break the Chains]

medalList.description:
You prevailed over formidable musings.
The name 'Ink Spirit' was one Saga chose. Before that, they all actually had their own names. Er, some of them were pretty adorable—did Dusk really pick them out? That immovable object?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Come To Yourself] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You traveled the landscapes of Dusk's scrolls, just as Saga did.
The fact Saga escaped by herself is something Dusk has taken to heart even now. After all, Saga's far too young a being. Doesn't it come off as degrading of Dusk's standing?
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Ask Yourself] and collect the rewards.

medalList.description:
You bore witness to an Operator's future.
Lava's already greatly grown, and become quite maturely steady, but she still revels in her additionally earned title of 'Purgatory,' despite it seeming a little redundant at that point.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, obtain Operator Lava the Purgatory.

medalList.description:
You collected a great deal of Dusk's beloved objects.
There's just one tiny little concern. Can you really take what you brought out of Dusk's scrolls, and throw them into a workshop rest assured?
medalList.getMethod: During the event, consume 2400 Dusk Inkstones in [Answer Yourself].

medalList.description:

No matter how deep into the abyss the secrets are hidden, they will surely all emerge into the world someday.

You understand everything that this prison break stands for.
When even rules can be bent because of the circumstances, what should we remain steadfast for?

You have built a reputation among the prisoners.
Your exquisite combat skills have even reached Warden Barton's ears, resulting in the bestowal of this medal.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, imprison prisoners a total of 50 times

medalList.description:
You have assisted a girl who is lost about the future.
It is hard to say she had almost fallen into the wrong path. The other path open to her may not be one full of missteps, though it is certainly not faultless either.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, obtain Operator Robin

medalList.description:
You have amassed a large amount of resources via the prisoners' special channels.
You have no idea where they obtained these resources, and you have no idea what their uses are inside the prison.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, consume 2400 Factory Steel in [Secret Channel]

medalList.description:
You have finished plotting out your prison break.
During the process, Mina discovered this medal by chance. It seems to be the warden's go-to gift for the dignitaries who visit the prison.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in 'Be Prepared!' and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You have successfully assisted Anthony's escape from the prison.
Though smog looms in the air outside, the air here also signifies freedom. This is where it all begins.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Escape Plan] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You have ensured the functionality of the majority of the devices here.
You have also discovered that certain models of these devices bear the Rhine Lab mark.
medalList.getMethod: Complete MB-EX-1 with a 3-star rating with at least 4 Imprisonment Devices remaining

medalList.description:
You have grown accustomed to the clashes between prisoners here. You are even enjoying it to some degree.
Perhaps Anthony should hand his position over to you.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Mansfield Daily Life] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
Much of the prisoners have surrendered to your 'power.'
The crystallization of technology and wisdom is not something that can be resisted with mere might.
medalList.getMethod: Complete MB-8 with a 3-star rating with at least 4 Imprisonment Devices remaining

medalList.description:
You have overcome the adverse circumstances by taking advantage of your surroundings.
Evidently, when we find ourselves unable to take on a problem with our strength alone, we must make up for it with our smarts. Brains and brawn, both complementing one another in perfect harmony.
medalList.getMethod: Complete MB-EX-8 with 3 stars, with at least 2 Imprisonment Devices remaining

All in the name of saving even more lives.

You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Cinder, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Cinder.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Cinder, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Cinder.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Cinder, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Cinder.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Cinder, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times

medalList.description:
You witnessed a knight's modern form. You soon witness a knight's fading afterglow.
In this era doomed beyond reproach, even if the road's futility is set in stone, the radiance still shines on.

You took full advantage of the rules.
At times, for the benefit of their own knights, coaches and sponsors will think of every trick in the book to shake out those luxury-lined VIP pockets wandering the exhibition room.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, shoot down a total of 50 Sponsor Drones, Luxury Sponsor Drones or Cheering Sponsor Drones

medalList.description:
You successfully rose in rank in the Major.
You'll find these commemorative medals all over the Grand Knight Territory, and they're very cheap. The 1st, 7th, 18th and 22nd medals within the series fetch the highest prices on the collectors' market.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Jousting Arena] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
Even from the jaws of a most sudden attack, you still snatched victory.
When faced with their executioners, sometimes you just need to give the General Chamber of Commerce a taste of their own medicine.
medalList.getMethod: Complete MN-8 with a 3-star rating while shooting down Sponsor Drones at least 4 times

medalList.description:
You defeated a powerful enemy with some help from outside.
Time was, arrogant knights would never rely on anything but fighting ability. But once the first knight, for victory, for the audience, for the fame and wealth, picked up a bottled blue drink dropped from a drone, everything changed.
medalList.getMethod: Complete MN-EX-8 with a 3-star rating while shooting down Sponsor Drones at least 3 times

medalList.description:
You competed with ever stronger knights.
Once, a group of knights fell to the losers' after the first game of the Major. On a legendary knight's sheer force of will, they won back game after game to finally reach the top. It's a legend furnished by each new telling, but the truth is, those knights promptly disbanded afterwards due to money problems.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Cage of Gloompincer] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You participated in all off-site events.
They say that if a person had twelve hours in the day to play, they'd still need a hundred years before they enjoyed every corner Kazimierz has to offer.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in [Offsite Activity Venue] and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You read a deluge of skin-deep media reports. We're sorry you had to.
What destroys the meaning of knights isn't just knights themselves. Every spectator who cheers has a responsibility, and every suit who manufactures those cheers is offending a creed.
medalList.getMethod: Read 15 piece(s) of news in Maria Nearl

medalList.description:
The coat of arms Zofia made for herself when she participated.
A coat of arms' significance has nowadays been worn bare, the original idea lost. But even so, Zofia still spent three of her afternoons carving away in earnest.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, obtain Operator Whislash

medalList.description:
You went on a shopping spree in the duty-free shop outside the arena.
Since it doesn't pay tax to the General Chamber of Commerce, it can sell its goods cheap, and an 'alarming' amount at that. A trap laid by consumerism.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, spend 2400 Mieszko Sports Securities in the Duty-Free Shop

medalList.description:
You endured a breathtakingly dangerous vacation. 
Brawls, indulgence, survival of the strongest, and little regard for the future. In places yet untouched by civilization, you found that life without technology can be quite wonderful indeed.

Your profound love for mushrooms is admirable.
However, for the sake of your health, please roast them before consumption.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, clear a total of 50 Giant Mushrooms

medalList.description:
Your wisdom has convinced this girl. 
We have reason to believe that upon learning to expand her horizons, she will do even better.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, obtain Operator Tomimi

medalList.description:
You spent a lot of money in Inam's shop. 
No merchant can hate a customer like you.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, spend 2400 Mechanical Parts in the 'Inam Committee'

medalList.description:
Your vacation has come to an end. 
Presumably, this joyous experience will leave a mark within your memories. We all know that there is much more on Terra than pain and suffering— though this is occasionally forgotten.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Great Chief's Path] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You completed an excellent challenge. 
Everyone admits that you are a true warrior.
medalList.getMethod: Complete RI-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms at least 5 times

medalList.description:
You overcame difficult missions. 
Gavial whole-heartedly commends your bravery.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Gavial's Footprints] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You thoroughly enjoyed your adventure. 
Zumama created this medal just for you.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in 'The Brave's Trials' and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
You maintained the self-control that symbolizes your status as a civilized person. 
But sometimes, giving in to indulgence isn't such a bad thing.
medalList.getMethod: Complete RI-8 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms no more than 2 times

medalList.description:
You have completely integrated into life here. 
Trusting in the power afforded to you by your own two hands is quite refreshing, isn't it?
medalList.getMethod: Complete RI-EX-8 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms at least 7 times

medalList.description:
A medal engraved with the blueprint of a certain lost weapon.
The weapons of the past cannot be reforged, but their will and spirit will remain in the world forever.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Blade.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Blade.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site

medalList.description:
An engraved medal proving your recruitment of an Operator during Operation Blade.
Imperfection does not mean that all is lost.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, obtain Operator Scene

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Blade.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles in unfamiliar terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Blade.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards

medalList.medalName: Blade: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Blade.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Blade.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Blade.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Blade.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Blade, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times

medalList.description:
You have witnessed everything.
The suspect is dead, the trail has gone cold, and the murderer has disappeared into the tempest of unrest. Only hatred remains to spring the trap, waiting for this side of Terra to fall into the net of law.

You resolved a case within a remote town in Leithanien.
Not everyone bears malice, but 'it' continues to slide deeper into the abyss.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Capitol Spire] with a 3-star rating, not including stages in the Occupied Zone (excluding tutorials)

medalList.description:
You took control of all 'Gramophones' and defeated the enemy leader.
The L-44 'Gramophone' is merely an industrial code and product name; the object itself actually does not have any of the functionalities of a gramophone. The rhythmic melody of a rock being struck can perhaps become a new form of music.
medalList.getMethod: Complete TW-8 with a 3-star rating while controlling all Gramophones at the time of victory

medalList.description:
You have learned this poem.
As the only person who knows the final chapter of this old man's life experience, you have pieced together the truth after weathering trials and tribulations. Please do not forget him.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in the Occupied Area of [Capitol Spire] on Tribulation Mode

medalList.description:
During the most perilous operation, you held onto control of the 'Gramophones.'
Perhaps you should also consider installing an Arts defense system like this?
medalList.getMethod: Complete TW-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while controlling all Gramophones at the time of victory

medalList.description:
You have overcome more challenging missions.
Victory brings the hope of unity and survival, giving Wolumonde a path forward.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Silent Frontier] on Challenge Mode

medalList.description:
You resolved the underlying reason for the riots.
Violence is not the answer to everything - order must be achieved.
medalList.getMethod: Complete TW-MO-1 with a 3-star rating

medalList.description:
A medal made by Folinic.
Not everyone is ready to come to terms with their past, nor should we ask for that.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, obtain Operator Folinic

medalList.description:
You spent a lot of money in Wolumonde.
Everyone is cheering because of the revitalized economy.
medalList.getMethod: During the event, spend 2400 Aristocrat's Antique Aureus in the 'August Fair'

medalList.description:
You deciphered the puzzle to reveal a part of the truth.
The old man was the king of his lofty history.
medalList.getMethod: Decipher any puzzle in the Antique Diary and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
This town will forever remember your contributions.
This tragedy may have been unpreventable, but the outcome could have been worse.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all the content in 'Burnt Offerings' and collect the rewards

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based on the insignia of a legendary mercenary time.
Accomplish what others have never done.
An engraved medal awarded to those who faced adversity during Operation Pyrite.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, reach a rating of S in the Permanent operation site

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who conquered desperation during Operation Pyrite.
You have overcome many challenges.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, reach a rating of SSS in the Permanent operation site

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that was bundled with a casual outfit obtained from Operation Pyrite.
Manticore might not understand the purpose of this, but you certainly do.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, purchase Manticore's outfit - Invisible Dirge

medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who stood on the front lines during Operation Pyrite.
You have proven your ability to command high-intensity battles in unfamiliar terrain.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, complete all rotating challenges (including daily Challenge Contracts and clearing Contingency 8) and collect the rewards for a total of 10 days.

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who responded to the shifting demands of Operation Pyrite.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, complete 1 Challenge Contract at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards

medalList.medalName: Pyrite: Call to Arms Medal II
medalList.description:
An engraved medal awarded to those who acted decisively during Operation Pyrite.
You have proven your ability to respond to various emergencies.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, complete 8 Challenge Contracts at the Permanent operation site and collect the rewards

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who crossed many battlefields during Operation Pyrite.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, unlock 4 Rank-3 Contracts for the Permanent operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who approached their missions with careful deliberation during Operation Pyrite.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, reach a rating of S at any Rotating operation site

medalList.description: An engraved medal awarded to those who helped each other during Operation Pyrite.
medalList.getMethod: During Operation Pyrite, use Friend Support to clear stages at any operation site no fewer than 5 times

medalList.description:
A gift Pallas brought back from a certain trip.
Human customs, heroic epics – she has a great deal of knowledge regarding her journey that she wishes to share with everyone.
medalList.getMethod: During the Reclamation Algorithm - Fire Within the Sand event, obtain the 'A Drip of Orea and Potamous' outfit.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal dedicated to those hard at work in logistics researching preparation methods and whipping up large amounts of food.
The tribespeople have been arguing for three days and nights about what makes for the ideal mate: a warrior who fights for the safety of the tribe, or a chef who is proficient in preparing all sorts of foods.
medalList.getMethod: During the Reclamation Algorithm - Fire Within the Sand event, make a total of 60 Provisions.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal issued to you for researching and developing a large number of tools and facilities.
Life will not let down one who has struggled so bitterly for its sake; if you must give, then you shall also receive.
medalList.getMethod: During the Reclamation Algorithm - Fire Within the Sand event, make a total of 100 Constructs.

medalList.description:
A medal to commemorate finding an ending that is uniquely yours among the sea of sands.
The sandsea surges, witnessing the rising and setting of the sun and moons, and the coming and going of newborn powers. We are naught but silent grains of sand.
medalList.getMethod: During the Reclamation Algorithm - Fire Within the Sand event, reach a victorious ending 1 time.

medalList.description:
Your dim, decaying past lies behind you, while new pressures await in front of you. The new city's Open Books and Shadow Ledger meet here.
'We gaze upon the same moons. We are moving in the same direction. However, we walk on different paths.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Crossing

medalList.description:
Before she left the tea house, Kestrel gave you this medal to thank you for allowing her to experience a different kind of joy in life.
At first, she was a bit more reserved, but after she became familiar with the rules, she and her flamboyant personality quickly became the center of attention at the card tables.
medalList.getMethod: During the Crossing event, obtain the outfit Charm of the Tiles

medalList.description: Life is to be celebrated, though trials and tribulations there may be. Live life to the fullest, and you shall have no regrets. The vessel may die and decay, but the spirit lives on.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Fantasy in the Mirage

medalList.description:
Medal that Bison gave you after completing the workouts, in gratitude for your guidance and trust.
The enthusiasm of youth, honed by trial and training.
medalList.getMethod: During the Fantasy in the Mirage event, obtain the outfit Soaring Will

medalList.description:
The canoe that shall carry you to tomorrow has already arrived at dock, marking the beginning of your next long journey.
Look, tomorrow is yet to come, but we've already arrived! Why not take a moment to catch our breath? The scenery along the way is ever so beautiful.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in See You Soon

medalList.description:
Verdant rides his motorcycle through bustling streets and narrow alleys. The balloons held by his 'scarecrow' drift in the wind, mirroring the festive mood of the people.
As he hustles about, delivering heartfelt messages, might he also attracts some admiring glances?
medalList.getMethod: During the See You Soon event, obtain the outfit Rose Rider

medalList.description:
With a great deal of effort, the departed ancestral spirits were finally sent back to the Furnace.
Perhaps this is an omen, signifying that the Soul Furnace's mission is nearing its end, or perhaps it foretells that after embracing nomadic city life, Kazdel will soon experience a profound rebirth.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in A Kazdelian Rescue

medalList.description:
Catapult hands you a medal she made herself as a thank-you gift for organizing this beach party.
Just then, a water bomb splashed across your face—and you realize this was her tactic to catch you off guard. You raise your own water gun to retaliate.
medalList.getMethod: During A Kazdelian Rescue event, obtain the Holiday HD66 outfit.

medalList.description:
Going off-course in life, coming to know your memories once more, and getting what you wished for in a different way.
'So, she hit her head 'cause she went into the mines without a helmet, right?'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in To the Grinning Valley

medalList.description:
A medal awarded to you by Earthspirit along with the survey report, as a gesture of appreciation for helping her organize her important geodetic survey data.
The marks time has left on the lands yet remain, on paper and on our hearts.
medalList.getMethod: During the To the Grinning Valley event, obtain the outfit Major Field.

medalList.description:
A new avenue of scientific inquiry, in a seemingly uncivilized land. Visitors arrive full of hope, unaware of the revelations of fate.
'Don't do anything rash, Southerners.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in The Black Forest Wills A Dream

medalList.description:
Ambriel thrust this medal into your hand, thanking you for spending a day at the beach and the dessert shop with her.
Hiding from the scorching sun beneath your shadow was the best idea she came up with.
medalList.getMethod: During The Black Forest Wills A Dream event, obtain the Holiday HD29 outfit.

medalList.description:
Chidao extends to the deepest parts of the wilderness. By following it, one can venture into the most obscure corners, the kind of life known to few.
If you must stop, stop.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in A Death in Chunfen

medalList.description:
An engraved medal drawn for you by Deepcolor herself to reward you for listening to her epic ordeals.
Perhaps you want to ask about where those mysterious imaging devices came from.
medalList.getMethod: During the A Death in Chunfen event, obtain the outfit Melodic Portrayal.

medalList.description:
The forward rumble of cities drowns out all clamorous ideals. Out beyond the cityways, they look back on the olden days, and bid farewell without a sound.
'I have no reason to abandon hope.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in An Obscure Wanderer

medalList.description:
What place could be better for losing yourself in study than the corner of the room, surrounded by books?
She's absolutely willing to spend most of her day snapping a pretty portrait, studying how she should lay out the props and what kind of face she should put on in front of the lens.
medalList.getMethod: During the An Obscure Wanderer event, obtain the outfit Disguise.

medalList.description:
Curtains close, the camera cuts away, the credits roll, the audience leaves, but the story of people never ends.
Time goes on, whether anyone is watching or not.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in To Be Continued

medalList.description:
When did he change? What made him what he is now? There is so much hard work and elbow grease waiting for us to discover.
Give him congratulations, praise, and recognition.
medalList.getMethod: During To Be Continued, obtain the outfit Traceless Walker.

medalList.description:
Beneath the overcast gloom of Caladon City, the spark called change is glowing. In the barrens further out, the spark is coming together as destruction greater still.
'You see, my friend, times have changed.'
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in A Light Spark in Darkness

medalList.description:
Just like the police in the movies, tearing about through public spaces, using anything they can to tussle with criminals, causing massive property damage... and then getting chewed out by their superiors.
Don't do this in real life, kids. They'll make you write a whole apology essay.
medalList.getMethod: During the A Light Spark in Darkness event, obtain the Jackie outfit reward in the Event Store

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that chronicles the struggles and anxieties of the Grand Knight Territory's youth.
Among the bustling crowds, each person is trying to find their own way.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Pinus Sylvestris

medalList.description:
A small badge hidden in the pocket of Click's costume. 
Click secretly brought lots of cameras along. After the fun ends, she'll come out with her edited story, and everyone's bound to have a great time.
medalList.getMethod: During the Pinus Sylvestris event, obtain outfit - Grave Thief

medalList.description:
This engraved medal is yours, this story is yours, and its meaning is yours and only yours.
Of course, you are no one but yourself, but it never hurts to try to learn more about yourself.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Vigilo

medalList.description:
A commemorative medal that came with your outfit purchase.
With each step, your horizons broadens further, bringing us new hope.
medalList.getMethod: During the Vigilo event, obtain outfit - Wasteland Walker

medalList.description:
A medal that commemorates the participating team's successful completion of the Twilight Frontier challenge in Interlocking Competition - Hymnoi Wisdom.
Solemnly awarded to the challenger by the defeated OpFor captain.
medalList.getMethod: Clear Twilight Frontier with a 3-star rating while defeating 2 or more 'Special OpFor Unit'

medalList.description:
An engraved medal depicting the countless people who hesitate and persevere.
As if to serve as a prelude to something far more sinister, their cries begin to ring in the air, just as lights begin to illuminate in the distance.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Preluding Lights

medalList.description:
An engraved medal that looks like a ripoff of a fairytale book cover. Bena claims this tale is famous all across Victoria.
There will come a time when the fairytale reaches its last page, and yet we must lift our heads up to face the world before us.
medalList.getMethod: During the Preluding Lights event, obtain Operator Bena

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based upon the field operation records of Rhodes Island's operators. Each and every footstep bears witness to the experiences the operators encountered.
Each and every moment, a story unfolds in a corner of the world.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Beyond Here

medalList.description:
A commemorative medal that came with your outfit purchase.
This particular design is both cozy and warm; Silence had an order placed on this outfit a long time ago.
medalList.getMethod: During the Beyond Here event, obtain outfit - Frosted Breath

medalList.description:
A stamp, carved by an operator, of the radiant light that struck them while they cooled out on the deck.
It's said that from birth to death, it's always the same breeze blowing by your side.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Rewinding Breeze

medalList.description:
In accordance with Operator Mint's description, this engraved seal depicts the teethmarks left after a book bites.
Books can bite people? Do books have teeth? Wait, can books even move?
medalList.getMethod: During the Rewinding Breeze event, obtain Operator Mint

medalList.description:
An engraved medal based upon the emblem of Peterheim Middle School.
Even though they're still not ready for it, they wish to walk towards tomorrow.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Children of Ursus

medalList.description:
An engraved medal restored using a police badge from Absinthe's collection.
Through bitterness and sorrow, life must continue.
medalList.getMethod: During the Children of Ursus event, purchase Absinthe's Token 1 time.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal designed from leftover cafeteria vouchers. No cash value, cannot be exchanged for Stories of Afternoon rewards.
There are more stories waiting to be told, and heard.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Stories of Afternoon

medalList.description:
An engraved medal made for the Base, bearing Nian's insignia.
There has yet to be a chef who can craft the kind of spiciness that Nian craves.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Ancient Forge

medalList.description:
A template-made engraved medal based upon the emblem used by Intelligence Certification in their archival work.
Our intelligence records will never be complete. The best we can do is to get as close as we can.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in Operational Intelligence

medalList.description:
Memories taken from the ashes. They are still burning, and only tears can douse these flames.
With all the fragments gathered, the story has now been fully restored.
medalList.getMethod: 'Do you yet remember those memories burning bright in the cracks between past and present?'

medalList.description:
Who could have imagined that, after all the complex calculations, the answer would be so simple and heartwarming?
Given the sincerity overflowing from these letters, perhaps you should consider writing a reply?
medalList.getMethod: 'Special requirements have been met. Feedback obtained from record restoration now being synchronized. Decoding in progress—'

medalList.description:
As a dream, as a fantasy. As a bubble, as a shadow.
All that is false, all is as real.
medalList.getMethod: 'A kind stranger from afar has opened her heart to you, and soon you will hear her story.'

medalList.description:
An engraved medal made in the image of the dishes served by the client from Iron Carrot City during the celebration banquet. 
The food was good and the portions filling. While a little lacking in presentation, there's not much to criticize about it.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Iron Carrot Mine Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client from the County of Toron during the celebration banquet. 
Even in a remote rural village, you can still experience Victorian hospitality.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Toron Mine Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client Rostov Industries during the celebration banquet.
Finely smoked delicacies made just for today's guests, together with black tea to sluice away the fat, and a healthy side of laughter and bluster.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Glebe Mining Platform Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client Słoma Foods during the celebration banquet.
'Three hours for a chef, three minutes at home!' brag the Słoma suits about their own firm's products.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Słoma Foods Processing Platform Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client from the Dossoles during the celebration banquet.
The artfully selected fillings had diners embark on a journey across half of Terra, yet the only thing that truly belongs to Dossoles is that golden-fried tortilla.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Under-Construction Dossoles Plate Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by Inam during the celebration banquet.
The celebrations lasted from noon until sundown. Even though the Tiacauh are still gorging themselves, you have already reached your limit.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Acahuallan Jungle Stationary Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
Medal based on the dishes offered by Mama John's at the thank-you banquet.
Only half a piece of lettuce and a thin meat patty remain in memory of the now-eaten extra large burger.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Mama John's New Plate Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
Medal based on the dishes offered by Raythean at the thank-you banquet.
Ready to eat after a little bit of roasting. The crispy skin and juicy meat is wholesome and filling, popular among the workers for its taste, and the managers for its cost-effectiveness.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Raythean Industries Test Platform Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description: An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the Alsterii Monastery during the celebration banquet. The ice cream balls are shaped as if they were shaved off the walls, and the edges of the waffles are smeared with an icing of inexplicable origin. The banquet was held on the platform after the crisis was resolved, and with this in mind, these things don't seem so strange after all.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Alsterii Bellariorum Manufacture Platform Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description: A medal inspired by the dishes prepared by the clients from the Inquisition during the celebration banquet. Slices of meat with uneven textures are spread across the reef. The meat's textures shimmer with oil, and you can smell a slight nutty aroma when you get closer. Only after breaking free from the shackles of the ocean's grasp does one realize how sweet the gift of land is.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Abandoned Lighthouse Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served during the celebration banquet by the client, Tower Mountains Biotech.
The sandworm legs, deep-fried to perfection, are packed full of juices that ooze out as you bite into the meat. The rumors about this delicacy are the least of anyone's concerns when confronted with this flavor. It was only after your meal that you learned the 'twenty-legged sandworm' was a pack of lies. There's no need for sandworms when their legs can be grown in vats.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Tower Mountains Agricultural Experimental Platform Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served during the celebration banquet by the client, the Terran Society For The Protection of Durin People.
After more rounds of drinks that anyone can possibly count, the inebriated Durin drift into slumber. Members of the Liquor Association lean on members of the Mead Fan Club, blending the rich aromas. The No. 10 Whiskey, also known as 'friendship.'
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Automaton Arena Security Service, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client Noise Correction Band during the celebration banquet.
The cakes are sweet and soft, with circular layers like rings of a tree, or a disc with joyful melodies. Supposedly, the patissier is a retired musician, and the secret to their fluffiness is the ditties he plays while they bake.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Nomadic Border Town Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
An engraved medal inspired by the dishes served by the client Box Inc. during the celebration banquet.
Box Inc. secretly recorded the entire commotion and how it was quelled, and is preparing to submit it for Wrankwood's 'Best Documentary' award. To thank all the 'actors' who helped make the film, they prepared a number of lunch boxes capable of making anyone lose their appetite.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Dossoles Commercial Plate Stationary Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
A medal inspired by the dishes served at the appreciation banquet hosted by the Royal Academy of Sciences.
Steamed potatoes, roast potatoes, chips, mashed potatoes… all accompanied by various icky looking side dishes and dipping sauces. The operators who participated reluctantly sampled each dish, unanimously concluding that this must be 'the taste of wisdom.'
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the War-torn Wilderness Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
A medal inspired by the drinks prepared at the appreciation banquet hosted by Ye Wuqing, the Rooftop Runner.
Before departing, she sincerely thanked Rhodes Island for putting up a show together with her to help her gather evidence to prove that the Baiyunjian Pharmacy tried to steal her family's medicinal tea recipe. They can now rest in peace. A leaf floats upright in the water, and the tea has a slightly bitter taste.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Yumen Market Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
A medal crafted in the style of the dishes served at the Leithanien Philharmonic Orchestra's appreciation banquet.
The head chef uses music to cast Arts, grilling his steak to perfection—crisp on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside. Unfortunately, the connoisseurs must play a song each time they serve a new dish, a rule which has given some of the operators indigestion.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Barren Beasts Concert Hall Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
Medal inspired by a dish at the appreciation banquet hosted by a client of Xingyu Logistics.
Miss Du has not neglected other business opportunities even as she spearheads the logistics business in Yumen. She has brought several famous dishes from Xingyu Inn to Yumen, including this blood curd hot pot recipe.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Shangshu Night Market Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description: A medal inspired by the special barbecue Diaz prepared for the thank-you party. Partly undercooked mushrooms sparked a small commotion. Though many artists claimed the taste was worth the risk, Diaz still pulled the mushrooms from the menu and asked Rhodes Island operators to distribute mushroom toxicity guides and safe-eating instructions.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Galería Ruins Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description:
Medal inspired by a dish at the appreciation banquet hosted by Karlan Trade.
Take top-rate cheese and carve it into the shape of the snowy Mt. Karlan, melt it with Kjerag's specialty ice wine when it's time to eat, stick a fork in it, dunk it in the molten cheese, then eat with relish. This free and easy pairing is beloved by Karlan Trade's staff, and is the first choice for many Kjeragi locals at house parties.
medalList.getMethod: The client promised that should there be no mistakes made during the Spier Foothills Security Mission, they would prepare a special appreciation feast for Rhodes Island.

medalList.description: All his master teaches him, Xiaohei has learnt extremely well.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock Luo Xiaohei's Operator Record 'Sleepwalker Sailing'

medalList.description:
There's no doubt that the day you found each other was a special one—why else would it float to the surface of your mind every day and night?
For on that day, you met him, and he met you, and from that day on, you had him, and he had a home.
medalList.getMethod: Unlock all the stories in It's Been A While

medalList.description:
You have come across a child made tense by unfamiliar surroundings.
After a lot of hesitation, he finally takes the hand you're holding out, and you can't help but break into a smile at the warmth of his palm.
medalList.getMethod: During the 'It's Been A While' event, obtain Operator Luo Xiaohei.

medalList.description:
You have given the Felynes, new arrivals to Terra, a job aboard Rhodes Island.
'In a-purr-reciation for providing us a work opportunity... we thank mew greatly!'
medalList.getMethod: During the 'A Flurry to the Flame' event, obtain Operators Terra Research Commission.

medalList.description:
You have beaten back the Rathalos, and led the residents of Roka Village in a safe evacuation.
The melting scars of this hunting spear tells of a journey, of a battle bathed in flame.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Soubo Mountains] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages).

medalList.description:
You met an expert at creating chaos on the battlefield.
By the time the others hear the sound of the explosion, he has already found the shortcut hidden behind smoke and rubble.
medalList.getMethod: Get Operator Fuze during Operation Lucent Arrowhead

medalList.description:
You visit a strange barbecue restaurant in an art museum.
Your efforts saved the museum from destruction. The previous owner did not mind the restaurant's presence, but he hated its name.
medalList.getMethod: Complete all stages in [Roam the Exhibition] with 3-star ratings during Operation Lucent Arrowhead (excluding tutorials and story stages).

medalList.description: Improve your diet, rethink your circadian rhythm, and engage in proper exercise. If you pay attention to these three things, your body will naturally get stronger.
medalList.getMethod: During the Delicious On Terra event, obtain Operator Senshi.

medalList.description:
Whether you wanted to know or not, you now have a detailed understanding of the composition, texture, flavor, and nutritional value of all sorts of plants and animals across Terra.
Don't take nature so lightly, though. After all, it's eat or be eaten, and you can't say for sure which you'll be.
medalList.getMethod: During the Delicious On Terra event, complete all stages in [Monster Gourmand] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages)

medalList.description:
That your precious companions have returned to your side is owed entirely to your efforts.
No matter how many times you part, you will always become one again.
medalList.getMethod: During the Somniloquium Serenum event, obtain Operators Umiri Yahata and Nyamu Yūtenji

medalList.description:
The songs and the screams from their souls, the instruments of their final concert, are forever bound to linger in your mind.
Stranger to you that some of their tribulations may be, you know their determination is made, their die cast, and they will stand and face the music. As will you one day, surely.
